Key Responsibilities

Transport Operations

• Oversee daily B2B and B2C outbound transportation activities from the Bedford warehouse.

• Plan and coordinate parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile collections according to order volume, service requirements and operational cut-off times.

• Allocate shipments to suitable carriers based on service type, capacity, cost, delivery requirements and operational performance.

• Ensure vehicles and carriers arrive as scheduled and that all shipments are dispatched within the required timeframes.

• Monitor shipment progress and proactively manage collection failures, delays, missed scans, delivery exceptions, damages, losses and returns.

• Support peak-period planning, contingency arrangements and urgent or ad-hoc transport requirements.

Carrier Management

• Act as the main operational contact between the Bedford warehouse and contracted carriers.

• Maintain effective daily communication with carrier account managers, depots, drivers and control teams.

• Conduct regular carrier performance reviews covering on-time collection, on-time delivery, scanning compliance, loss and damage, claims, customer complaints and service failures.

• Escalate recurring issues and drive carriers to provide root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.

• Support carrier onboarding, operational testing, service changes and the implementation of new transport solutions.

• Verify that carriers follow agreed SOPs, service requirements, safety standards and contractual obligations.

• Work with procurement and management teams to support carrier reviews, cost control and continuous improvement.

Warehouse Handover and Dispatch Control

• Work closely with the warehouse outbound team to align picking, packing, staging, loading and carrier collection schedules.

• Establish and maintain a clear handover process between warehouse and transportation teams.

• Confirm shipment quantities, pallet or parcel counts, labels, manifests and supporting documentation before goods are released.

• Ensure all physical handovers and system handovers are properly recorded and traceable.

• Investigate discrepancies between physical goods, system records and carrier collection data.

• Coordinate the safe and efficient loading of vehicles and ensure goods are handed over to the correct carrier.

• Conduct daily reviews of outstanding, uncollected or unsuccessfully dispatched shipments.

Team Leadership

• Lead and coordinate a small transport operations team responsible for dispatch planning, carrier communication and shipment monitoring.

• Allocate daily tasks and ensure appropriate operational coverage throughout the working day.

• Provide training, coaching and operational guidance to team members.

• Monitor team performance and ensure issues are escalated and resolved promptly.

• Maintain clear SOPs, shift handovers and escalation procedures.

• Promote strong collaboration between transportation, warehouse operations, customer service, procurement and other internal teams.

Compliance and Reporting

• Ensure transportation activities comply with company procedures and applicable UK transport, health and safety and security requirements.

• Support compliant handling and transportation of dangerous goods where applicable.

• Maintain accurate transport records, manifests, proof of collection, delivery evidence and exception records.

• Produce daily and weekly reports covering shipment volumes, carrier performance, operational exceptions and outstanding actions.

• Identify operational risks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

• Support internal audits, carrier investigations and customer claims where required.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured against areas including:

• On-time carrier collection

• On-time dispatch and delivery performance

• Successful warehouse-to-carrier handover

• Shipment scanning and tracking compliance

• Loss, damage and claims performance

• Transport exception closure time

• Carrier capacity fulfilment

• Customer complaint levels

• Transport cost and operational efficiency

• Team productivity and SOP compliance

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience in transportation, carrier management, dispatch or logistics operations.

• Practical experience managing B2B and B2C outbound shipments.

• Experience working directly with parcel carriers, pallet networks, freight providers or last-mile delivery companies.

• Previous experience leading, supervising or coordinating a small operational team.

• Strong understanding of warehouse dispatch, shipment handover and carrier collection processes.

• Ability to manage multiple carriers, priorities and operational exceptions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and escalation-management skills.

• Confident user of transportation, warehouse or carrier-management systems.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.

• Fluent spoken and written English and Mandarin Chinese.

• Eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience working in an e-commerce, retail, fulfilment or third-party logistics environment.

• Experience managing high-volume parcel and last-mile operations.

• Knowledge of UK parcel, pallet and freight carrier networks.

• Experience handling dangerous goods or working in a dangerous-goods warehouse environment.

• Knowledge of ADR requirements and dangerous-goods transport documentation.

• Experience with transport management systems, warehouse management systems and carrier portals.

Job Purpose

We are looking for a Quality Inspector to join our Reverse Logistics team, responsible for inspecting and assessing high-value returned consumer electronics, including mobile phones, graphics cards, gaming consoles and other electronic products.

The role will focus on product inspection, functionality testing, fraud and abnormality identification, and ensuring returned products are accurately assessed and processed.

Key Responsibilities

• Receive and inspect high-value returned electronics, including mobile phones, graphics cards, gaming consoles and other consumer electronic products.

• Conduct inspections in accordance with SOPs, including serial number/IMEI verification, cosmetic condition, functionality, accessories and packaging completeness.

• Identify product substitution, tampering, component replacement, counterfeit products, missing parts and other abnormalities.

• Carry out further disassembly, hardware and performance testing for suspicious or abnormal products where required.

• Support authenticity verification and investigation of potentially fraudulent returns.

• Maintain accurate inspection records and supporting evidence, including photographs and videos, and record results correctly in the relevant systems.

• Determine the appropriate product disposition based on inspection results, including return to stock, refurbishment or repair, second-hand grading, exception handling or disposal.

• Review recurring abnormal return cases and support improvements to inspection standards, SOPs and risk-identification processes.

Requirements

• Previous experience in electronic product inspection, testing or repair, particularly with mobile phones, computers, graphics cards, gaming consoles or similar products.

• 2+ years of relevant experience is preferred.

• Good understanding of consumer electronics hardware, product functionality and basic fault diagnosis.

• Ability to identify signs of tampering, component replacement, product substitution, missing parts and other abnormalities.

• Experience in electronics repair, refurbishment, quality inspection or used-electronics assessment is highly desirable.

• Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.

• Good problem-solving and analytical skills.

• Ability to maintain clear and accurate inspection records and supporting evidence.

• No specific professional certification is required.

Category / Brand Planning: Based on the current status and characteristics of the assigned category/brand, industry trends, platform features, consumer insights, sales data, and business strategy, conduct industry insights, data analysis, iteration, and strategic goal breakdown to plan category structures (e.g., category layout, brand structure, product line structure), formulate category strategies and development plans, and define corresponding growth strategies.

Establish mechanisms for supplier negotiations, rebate and cost management, and regular business reviews. Oversee logistics from supplier to JD warehouses (including delivery timelines, carriers, fulfillment methods, and understanding supplier production bases and warehouse networks). Review and sign annual contracts, and manage after-sales service for supplier products.

Product Operations and Marketing: Based on market competition and brand strategy, manage core product operations such as product listing/removal, availability status, and label creation. Develop and adjust pricing strategies for products within the category. Collaborate with suppliers to optimize product detail pages, store presentation, main images, ad copy, live streaming, and short videos to enhance user experience. Job Description

Job Title: Transport Specialist – Carrier Management

Location: Bedford, UK
Department: Transportation / Supply Chain
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Language Requirement: Fluent English and Mandarin Chinese
Working Arrangement: On-site; flexibility to support operational shifts and peak periods may be required

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Transport Specialist to oversee carrier management and outbound transportation operations at our Bedford warehouse.

The role will coordinate both B2B and B2C outbound shipments, manage day-to-day communication and performance with parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile carriers, and lead a small transportation operations team.

The successful candidate will work closely with the warehouse outbound team to ensure an accurate and controlled handover of goods, timely carrier collections and effective resolution of operational exceptions. This position requires strong transportation knowledge, excellent stakeholder-management skills and the ability to communicate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Key Responsibilities

Transport Operations

• Oversee daily B2B and B2C outbound transportation activities from the Bedford warehouse.

• Plan and coordinate parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile collections according to order volume, service requirements and operational cut-off times.

• Allocate shipments to suitable carriers based on service type, capacity, cost, delivery requirements and operational performance.

• Ensure vehicles and carriers arrive as scheduled and that all shipments are dispatched within the required timeframes.

• Monitor shipment progress and proactively manage collection failures, delays, missed scans, delivery exceptions, damages, losses and returns.

• Support peak-period planning, contingency arrangements and urgent or ad-hoc transport requirements.

Carrier Management

• Act as the main operational contact between the Bedford warehouse and contracted carriers.

• Maintain effective daily communication with carrier account managers, depots, drivers and control teams.

• Conduct regular carrier performance reviews covering on-time collection, on-time delivery, scanning compliance, loss and damage, claims, customer complaints and service failures.

• Escalate recurring issues and drive carriers to provide root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.

• Support carrier onboarding, operational testing, service changes and the implementation of new transport solutions.

• Verify that carriers follow agreed SOPs, service requirements, safety standards and contractual obligations.

• Work with procurement and management teams to support carrier reviews, cost control and continuous improvement.

Warehouse Handover and Dispatch Control

• Work closely with the warehouse outbound team to align picking, packing, staging, loading and carrier collection schedules.

• Establish and maintain a clear handover process between warehouse and transportation teams.

• Confirm shipment quantities, pallet or parcel counts, labels, manifests and supporting documentation before goods are released.

• Ensure all physical handovers and system handovers are properly recorded and traceable.

• Investigate discrepancies between physical goods, system records and carrier collection data.

• Coordinate the safe and efficient loading of vehicles and ensure goods are handed over to the correct carrier.

• Conduct daily reviews of outstanding, uncollected or unsuccessfully dispatched shipments.

Team Leadership

• Lead and coordinate a small transport operations team responsible for dispatch planning, carrier communication and shipment monitoring.

• Allocate daily tasks and ensure appropriate operational coverage throughout the working day.

• Provide training, coaching and operational guidance to team members.

• Monitor team performance and ensure issues are escalated and resolved promptly.

• Maintain clear SOPs, shift handovers and escalation procedures.

• Promote strong collaboration between transportation, warehouse operations, customer service, procurement and other internal teams.

Compliance and Reporting

• Ensure transportation activities comply with company procedures and applicable UK transport, health and safety and security requirements.

• Support compliant handling and transportation of dangerous goods where applicable.

• Maintain accurate transport records, manifests, proof of collection, delivery evidence and exception records.

• Produce daily and weekly reports covering shipment volumes, carrier performance, operational exceptions and outstanding actions.

• Identify operational risks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

• Support internal audits, carrier investigations and customer claims where required.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured against areas including:

• On-time carrier collection

• On-time dispatch and delivery performance

• Successful warehouse-to-carrier handover

• Shipment scanning and tracking compliance

• Loss, damage and claims performance

• Transport exception closure time

• Carrier capacity fulfilment

• Customer complaint levels

• Transport cost and operational efficiency

• Team productivity and SOP compliance

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience in transportation, carrier management, dispatch or logistics operations.

• Practical experience managing B2B and B2C outbound shipments.

• Experience working directly with parcel carriers, pallet networks, freight providers or last-mile delivery companies.

• Previous experience leading, supervising or coordinating a small operational team.

• Strong understanding of warehouse dispatch, shipment handover and carrier collection processes.

• Ability to manage multiple carriers, priorities and operational exceptions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and escalation-management skills.

• Confident user of transportation, warehouse or carrier-management systems.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.

• Fluent spoken and written English and Mandarin Chinese.

• Eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience working in an e-commerce, retail, fulfilment or third-party logistics environment.

• Experience managing high-volume parcel and last-mile operations.

• Knowledge of UK parcel, pallet and freight carrier networks.

• Experience handling dangerous goods or working in a dangerous-goods warehouse environment.

• Knowledge of ADR requirements and dangerous-goods transport documentation.

• Experience with transport management systems, warehouse management systems and carrier portals.

• Experience conducting carrier performance reviews and managing corrective action plans.

• Transport Manager CPC or another relevant logistics qualification would be advantageous but is not essential.

Personal Attributes

• Hands-on, organised and comfortable working in a warehouse environment.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Calm and decisive when managing operational pressure and service failures.

• Clear and confident communicator with both internal teams and external carriers.

• Able to challenge poor performance professionally and drive issues through to resolution.

• Detail-oriented, commercially aware and focused on continuous improvement.

• Capable of working effectively across Chinese and UK business cultures.

About The Team

Job Description

Job Title: Transport Specialist – Carrier Management

Location: Bedford, UK
Department: Transportation / Supply Chain
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Language Requirement: Fluent English and Mandarin Chinese
Working Arrangement: On-site; flexibility to support operational shifts and peak periods may be required

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Transport Specialist to oversee carrier management and outbound transportation operations at our Bedford warehouse.

The role will coordinate both B2B and B2C outbound shipments, manage day-to-day communication and performance with parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile carriers, and lead a small transportation operations team.

The successful candidate will work closely with the warehouse outbound team to ensure an accurate and controlled handover of goods, timely carrier collections and effective resolution of operational exceptions. This position requires strong transportation knowledge, excellent stakeholder-management skills and the ability to communicate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Key Responsibilities

Transport Operations

• Oversee daily B2B and B2C outbound transportation activities from the Bedford warehouse.

• Plan and coordinate parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile collections according to order volume, service requirements and operational cut-off times.

• Allocate shipments to suitable carriers based on service type, capacity, cost, delivery requirements and operational performance.

• Ensure vehicles and carriers arrive as scheduled and that all shipments are dispatched within the required timeframes.

• Monitor shipment progress and proactively manage collection failures, delays, missed scans, delivery exceptions, damages, losses and returns.

• Support peak-period planning, contingency arrangements and urgent or ad-hoc transport requirements.

Carrier Management

• Act as the main operational contact between the Bedford warehouse and contracted carriers.

• Maintain effective daily communication with carrier account managers, depots, drivers and control teams.

• Conduct regular carrier performance reviews covering on-time collection, on-time delivery, scanning compliance, loss and damage, claims, customer complaints and service failures.

• Escalate recurring issues and drive carriers to provide root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.

• Support carrier onboarding, operational testing, service changes and the implementation of new transport solutions.

• Verify that carriers follow agreed SOPs, service requirements, safety standards and contractual obligations.

• Work with procurement and management teams to support carrier reviews, cost control and continuous improvement.

Warehouse Handover and Dispatch Control

• Work closely with the warehouse outbound team to align picking, packing, staging, loading and carrier collection schedules.

• Establish and maintain a clear handover process between warehouse and transportation teams.

• Confirm shipment quantities, pallet or parcel counts, labels, manifests and supporting documentation before goods are released.

• Ensure all physical handovers and system handovers are properly recorded and traceable.

• Investigate discrepancies between physical goods, system records and carrier collection data.

• Coordinate the safe and efficient loading of vehicles and ensure goods are handed over to the correct carrier.

• Conduct daily reviews of outstanding, uncollected or unsuccessfully dispatched shipments.

Team Leadership

• Lead and coordinate a small transport operations team responsible for dispatch planning, carrier communication and shipment monitoring.

• Allocate daily tasks and ensure appropriate operational coverage throughout the working day.

• Provide training, coaching and operational guidance to team members.

• Monitor team performance and ensure issues are escalated and resolved promptly.

• Maintain clear SOPs, shift handovers and escalation procedures.

• Promote strong collaboration between transportation, warehouse operations, customer service, procurement and other internal teams.

Compliance and Reporting

• Ensure transportation activities comply with company procedures and applicable UK transport, health and safety and security requirements.

• Support compliant handling and transportation of dangerous goods where applicable.

• Maintain accurate transport records, manifests, proof of collection, delivery evidence and exception records.

• Produce daily and weekly reports covering shipment volumes, carrier performance, operational exceptions and outstanding actions.

• Identify operational risks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

• Support internal audits, carrier investigations and customer claims where required.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured against areas including:

• On-time carrier collection

• On-time dispatch and delivery performance

• Successful warehouse-to-carrier handover

• Shipment scanning and tracking compliance

• Loss, damage and claims performance

• Transport exception closure time

• Carrier capacity fulfilment

• Customer complaint levels

• Transport cost and operational efficiency

• Team productivity and SOP compliance

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience in transportation, carrier management, dispatch or logistics operations.

• Practical experience managing B2B and B2C outbound shipments.

• Experience working directly with parcel carriers, pallet networks, freight providers or last-mile delivery companies.

• Previous experience leading, supervising or coordinating a small operational team.

• Strong understanding of warehouse dispatch, shipment handover and carrier collection processes.

• Ability to manage multiple carriers, priorities and operational exceptions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and escalation-management skills.

• Confident user of transportation, warehouse or carrier-management systems.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.

• Fluent spoken and written English and Mandarin Chinese.

• Eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience working in an e-commerce, retail, fulfilment or third-party logistics environment.

• Experience managing high-volume parcel and last-mile operations.

• Knowledge of UK parcel, pallet and freight carrier networks.

• Experience handling dangerous goods or working in a dangerous-goods warehouse environment.

• Knowledge of ADR requirements and dangerous-goods transport documentation.

• Experience with transport management systems, warehouse management systems and carrier portals.

• Experience conducting carrier performance reviews and managing corrective action plans.

• Transport Manager CPC or another relevant logistics qualification would be advantageous but is not essential.

Personal Attributes

• Hands-on, organised and comfortable working in a warehouse environment.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Calm and decisive when managing operational pressure and service failures.

• Clear and confident communicator with both internal teams and external carriers.

• Able to challenge poor performance professionally and drive issues through to resolution.

• Detail-oriented, commercially aware and focused on continuous improvement.

• Capable of working effectively across Chinese and UK business cultures.

Job Description

Job Title: Transport Specialist – Carrier Management

Location: Bedford, UK
Department: Transportation / Supply Chain
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Language Requirement: Fluent English and Mandarin Chinese
Working Arrangement: On-site; flexibility to support operational shifts and peak periods may be required

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Transport Specialist to oversee carrier management and outbound transportation operations at our Bedford warehouse.

The role will coordinate both B2B and B2C outbound shipments, manage day-to-day communication and performance with parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile carriers, and lead a small transportation operations team.

The successful candidate will work closely with the warehouse outbound team to ensure an accurate and controlled handover of goods, timely carrier collections and effective resolution of operational exceptions. This position requires strong transportation knowledge, excellent stakeholder-management skills and the ability to communicate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Key Responsibilities

Transport Operations

• Oversee daily B2B and B2C outbound transportation activities from the Bedford warehouse.

• Plan and coordinate parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile collections according to order volume, service requirements and operational cut-off times.

• Allocate shipments to suitable carriers based on service type, capacity, cost, delivery requirements and operational performance.

• Ensure vehicles and carriers arrive as scheduled and that all shipments are dispatched within the required timeframes.

• Monitor shipment progress and proactively manage collection failures, delays, missed scans, delivery exceptions, damages, losses and returns.

• Support peak-period planning, contingency arrangements and urgent or ad-hoc transport requirements.

Carrier Management

• Act as the main operational contact between the Bedford warehouse and contracted carriers.

• Maintain effective daily communication with carrier account managers, depots, drivers and control teams.

• Conduct regular carrier performance reviews covering on-time collection, on-time delivery, scanning compliance, loss and damage, claims, customer complaints and service failures.

• Escalate recurring issues and drive carriers to provide root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.

• Support carrier onboarding, operational testing, service changes and the implementation of new transport solutions.

• Verify that carriers follow agreed SOPs, service requirements, safety standards and contractual obligations.

• Work with procurement and management teams to support carrier reviews, cost control and continuous improvement.

Warehouse Handover and Dispatch Control

• Work closely with the warehouse outbound team to align picking, packing, staging, loading and carrier collection schedules.

• Establish and maintain a clear handover process between warehouse and transportation teams.

• Confirm shipment quantities, pallet or parcel counts, labels, manifests and supporting documentation before goods are released.

• Ensure all physical handovers and system handovers are properly recorded and traceable.

• Investigate discrepancies between physical goods, system records and carrier collection data.

• Coordinate the safe and efficient loading of vehicles and ensure goods are handed over to the correct carrier.

• Conduct daily reviews of outstanding, uncollected or unsuccessfully dispatched shipments.

Team Leadership

• Lead and coordinate a small transport operations team responsible for dispatch planning, carrier communication and shipment monitoring.

• Allocate daily tasks and ensure appropriate operational coverage throughout the working day.

• Provide training, coaching and operational guidance to team members.

• Monitor team performance and ensure issues are escalated and resolved promptly.

• Maintain clear SOPs, shift handovers and escalation procedures.

• Promote strong collaboration between transportation, warehouse operations, customer service, procurement and other internal teams.

Compliance and Reporting

• Ensure transportation activities comply with company procedures and applicable UK transport, health and safety and security requirements.

• Support compliant handling and transportation of dangerous goods where applicable.

• Maintain accurate transport records, manifests, proof of collection, delivery evidence and exception records.

• Produce daily and weekly reports covering shipment volumes, carrier performance, operational exceptions and outstanding actions.

• Identify operational risks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

• Support internal audits, carrier investigations and customer claims where required.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured against areas including:

• On-time carrier collection

• On-time dispatch and delivery performance

• Successful warehouse-to-carrier handover

• Shipment scanning and tracking compliance

• Loss, damage and claims performance

• Transport exception closure time

• Carrier capacity fulfilment

• Customer complaint levels

• Transport cost and operational efficiency

• Team productivity and SOP compliance

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience in transportation, carrier management, dispatch or logistics operations.

• Practical experience managing B2B and B2C outbound shipments.

• Experience working directly with parcel carriers, pallet networks, freight providers or last-mile delivery companies.

• Previous experience leading, supervising or coordinating a small operational team.

• Strong understanding of warehouse dispatch, shipment handover and carrier collection processes.

• Ability to manage multiple carriers, priorities and operational exceptions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and escalation-management skills.

• Confident user of transportation, warehouse or carrier-management systems.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.

• Fluent spoken and written English and Mandarin Chinese.

• Eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience working in an e-commerce, retail, fulfilment or third-party logistics environment.

• Experience managing high-volume parcel and last-mile operations.

• Knowledge of UK parcel, pallet and freight carrier networks.

• Experience handling dangerous goods or working in a dangerous-goods warehouse environment.

• Knowledge of ADR requirements and dangerous-goods transport documentation.

• Experience with transport management systems, warehouse management systems and carrier portals.

• Experience conducting carrier performance reviews and managing corrective action plans.

• Transport Manager CPC or another relevant logistics qualification would be advantageous but is not essential.

Personal Attributes

• Hands-on, organised and comfortable working in a warehouse environment.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Calm and decisive when managing operational pressure and service failures.

• Clear and confident communicator with both internal teams and external carriers.

• Able to challenge poor performance professionally and drive issues through to resolution.

• Detail-oriented, commercially aware and focused on continuous improvement.

• Capable of working effectively across Chinese and UK business cultures.

Job Description

Job Title: Transport Specialist – Carrier Management

Location: Bedford, UK
Department: Transportation / Supply Chain
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Language Requirement: Fluent English and Mandarin Chinese
Working Arrangement: On-site; flexibility to support operational shifts and peak periods may be required

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Transport Specialist to oversee carrier management and outbound transportation operations at our Bedford warehouse.

The role will coordinate both B2B and B2C outbound shipments, manage day-to-day communication and performance with parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile carriers, and lead a small transportation operations team.

The successful candidate will work closely with the warehouse outbound team to ensure an accurate and controlled handover of goods, timely carrier collections and effective resolution of operational exceptions. This position requires strong transportation knowledge, excellent stakeholder-management skills and the ability to communicate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Key Responsibilities

Transport Operations

• Oversee daily B2B and B2C outbound transportation activities from the Bedford warehouse.

• Plan and coordinate parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile collections according to order volume, service requirements and operational cut-off times.

• Allocate shipments to suitable carriers based on service type, capacity, cost, delivery requirements and operational performance.

• Ensure vehicles and carriers arrive as scheduled and that all shipments are dispatched within the required timeframes.

• Monitor shipment progress and proactively manage collection failures, delays, missed scans, delivery exceptions, damages, losses and returns.

• Support peak-period planning, contingency arrangements and urgent or ad-hoc transport requirements.

Carrier Management

• Act as the main operational contact between the Bedford warehouse and contracted carriers.

• Maintain effective daily communication with carrier account managers, depots, drivers and control teams.

• Conduct regular carrier performance reviews covering on-time collection, on-time delivery, scanning compliance, loss and damage, claims, customer complaints and service failures.

• Escalate recurring issues and drive carriers to provide root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.

• Support carrier onboarding, operational testing, service changes and the implementation of new transport solutions.

• Verify that carriers follow agreed SOPs, service requirements, safety standards and contractual obligations.

• Work with procurement and management teams to support carrier reviews, cost control and continuous improvement.

Warehouse Handover and Dispatch Control

• Work closely with the warehouse outbound team to align picking, packing, staging, loading and carrier collection schedules.

• Establish and maintain a clear handover process between warehouse and transportation teams.

• Confirm shipment quantities, pallet or parcel counts, labels, manifests and supporting documentation before goods are released.

• Ensure all physical handovers and system handovers are properly recorded and traceable.

• Investigate discrepancies between physical goods, system records and carrier collection data.

• Coordinate the safe and efficient loading of vehicles and ensure goods are handed over to the correct carrier.

• Conduct daily reviews of outstanding, uncollected or unsuccessfully dispatched shipments.

Team Leadership

• Lead and coordinate a small transport operations team responsible for dispatch planning, carrier communication and shipment monitoring.

• Allocate daily tasks and ensure appropriate operational coverage throughout the working day.

• Provide training, coaching and operational guidance to team members.

• Monitor team performance and ensure issues are escalated and resolved promptly.

• Maintain clear SOPs, shift handovers and escalation procedures.

• Promote strong collaboration between transportation, warehouse operations, customer service, procurement and other internal teams.

Compliance and Reporting

• Ensure transportation activities comply with company procedures and applicable UK transport, health and safety and security requirements.

• Support compliant handling and transportation of dangerous goods where applicable.

• Maintain accurate transport records, manifests, proof of collection, delivery evidence and exception records.

• Produce daily and weekly reports covering shipment volumes, carrier performance, operational exceptions and outstanding actions.

• Identify operational risks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

• Support internal audits, carrier investigations and customer claims where required.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured against areas including:

• On-time carrier collection

• On-time dispatch and delivery performance

• Successful warehouse-to-carrier handover

• Shipment scanning and tracking compliance

• Loss, damage and claims performance

• Transport exception closure time

• Carrier capacity fulfilment

• Customer complaint levels

• Transport cost and operational efficiency

• Team productivity and SOP compliance

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience in transportation, carrier management, dispatch or logistics operations.

• Practical experience managing B2B and B2C outbound shipments.

• Experience working directly with parcel carriers, pallet networks, freight providers or last-mile delivery companies.

• Previous experience leading, supervising or coordinating a small operational team.

• Strong understanding of warehouse dispatch, shipment handover and carrier collection processes.

• Ability to manage multiple carriers, priorities and operational exceptions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and escalation-management skills.

• Confident user of transportation, warehouse or carrier-management systems.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.

• Fluent spoken and written English and Mandarin Chinese.

• Eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience working in an e-commerce, retail, fulfilment or third-party logistics environment.

• Experience managing high-volume parcel and last-mile operations.

• Knowledge of UK parcel, pallet and freight carrier networks.

• Experience handling dangerous goods or working in a dangerous-goods warehouse environment.

• Knowledge of ADR requirements and dangerous-goods transport documentation.

• Experience with transport management systems, warehouse management systems and carrier portals.

• Experience conducting carrier performance reviews and managing corrective action plans.

• Transport Manager CPC or another relevant logistics qualification would be advantageous but is not essential.

Personal Attributes

• Hands-on, organised and comfortable working in a warehouse environment.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Calm and decisive when managing operational pressure and service failures.

• Clear and confident communicator with both internal teams and external carriers.

• Able to challenge poor performance professionally and drive issues through to resolution.

• Detail-oriented, commercially aware and focused on continuous improvement.

• Capable of working effectively across Chinese and UK business cultures.

Category / Brand Planning: Based on the current status and characteristics of the assigned category/brand, industry trends, platform features, consumer insights, sales data, and business strategy, conduct industry insights, data analysis, iteration, and strategic goal breakdown to plan category structures (e.g., category layout, brand structure, product line structure), formulate category strategies and development plans, and define corresponding growth strategies.

Oversee logistics from supplier to JD warehouses (including delivery timelines, carriers, fulfillment methods, and understanding supplier production bases and warehouse networks). Review and sign annual contracts, and manage after-sales service for supplier products.

Product Operations and Marketing: Based on market competition and brand strategy, manage core product operations such as product listing/removal, availability status, and label creation. Develop and adjust pricing strategies for products within the category. Collaborate with suppliers to optimize product detail pages, store presentation, main images, ad copy, live streaming, and short videos to enhance user experience. Job Description

Job Title: Transport Specialist – Carrier Management

Location: Bedford, UK
Department: Transportation / Supply Chain
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Language Requirement: Fluent English and Mandarin Chinese
Working Arrangement: On-site; flexibility to support operational shifts and peak periods may be required

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Transport Specialist to oversee carrier management and outbound transportation operations at our Bedford warehouse.

The role will coordinate both B2B and B2C outbound shipments, manage day-to-day communication and performance with parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile carriers, and lead a small transportation operations team.

The successful candidate will work closely with the warehouse outbound team to ensure an accurate and controlled handover of goods, timely carrier collections and effective resolution of operational exceptions. This position requires strong transportation knowledge, excellent stakeholder-management skills and the ability to communicate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Key Responsibilities

Transport Operations

• Oversee daily B2B and B2C outbound transportation activities from the Bedford warehouse.

• Plan and coordinate parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile collections according to order volume, service requirements and operational cut-off times.

• Allocate shipments to suitable carriers based on service type, capacity, cost, delivery requirements and operational performance.

• Ensure vehicles and carriers arrive as scheduled and that all shipments are dispatched within the required timeframes.

• Monitor shipment progress and proactively manage collection failures, delays, missed scans, delivery exceptions, damages, losses and returns.

• Support peak-period planning, contingency arrangements and urgent or ad-hoc transport requirements.

Carrier Management

• Act as the main operational contact between the Bedford warehouse and contracted carriers.

• Maintain effective daily communication with carrier account managers, depots, drivers and control teams.

• Conduct regular carrier performance reviews covering on-time collection, on-time delivery, scanning compliance, loss and damage, claims, customer complaints and service failures.

• Escalate recurring issues and drive carriers to provide root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.

• Support carrier onboarding, operational testing, service changes and the implementation of new transport solutions.

• Verify that carriers follow agreed SOPs, service requirements, safety standards and contractual obligations.

• Work with procurement and management teams to support carrier reviews, cost control and continuous improvement.

Warehouse Handover and Dispatch Control

• Work closely with the warehouse outbound team to align picking, packing, staging, loading and carrier collection schedules.

• Establish and maintain a clear handover process between warehouse and transportation teams.

• Confirm shipment quantities, pallet or parcel counts, labels, manifests and supporting documentation before goods are released.

• Ensure all physical handovers and system handovers are properly recorded and traceable.

• Investigate discrepancies between physical goods, system records and carrier collection data.

• Coordinate the safe and efficient loading of vehicles and ensure goods are handed over to the correct carrier.

• Conduct daily reviews of outstanding, uncollected or unsuccessfully dispatched shipments.

Team Leadership

• Lead and coordinate a small transport operations team responsible for dispatch planning, carrier communication and shipment monitoring.

• Allocate daily tasks and ensure appropriate operational coverage throughout the working day.

• Provide training, coaching and operational guidance to team members.

• Monitor team performance and ensure issues are escalated and resolved promptly.

• Maintain clear SOPs, shift handovers and escalation procedures.

• Promote strong collaboration between transportation, warehouse operations, customer service, procurement and other internal teams.

Compliance and Reporting

• Ensure transportation activities comply with company procedures and applicable UK transport, health and safety and security requirements.

• Support compliant handling and transportation of dangerous goods where applicable.

• Maintain accurate transport records, manifests, proof of collection, delivery evidence and exception records.

• Produce daily and weekly reports covering shipment volumes, carrier performance, operational exceptions and outstanding actions.

• Identify operational risks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

• Support internal audits, carrier investigations and customer claims where required.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured against areas including:

• On-time carrier collection

• On-time dispatch and delivery performance

• Successful warehouse-to-carrier handover

• Shipment scanning and tracking compliance

• Loss, damage and claims performance

• Transport exception closure time

• Carrier capacity fulfilment

• Customer complaint levels

• Transport cost and operational efficiency

• Team productivity and SOP compliance

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience in transportation, carrier management, dispatch or logistics operations.

• Practical experience managing B2B and B2C outbound shipments.

• Experience working directly with parcel carriers, pallet networks, freight providers or last-mile delivery companies.

• Previous experience leading, supervising or coordinating a small operational team.

• Strong understanding of warehouse dispatch, shipment handover and carrier collection processes.

• Ability to manage multiple carriers, priorities and operational exceptions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and escalation-management skills.

• Confident user of transportation, warehouse or carrier-management systems.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.

• Fluent spoken and written English and Mandarin Chinese.

• Eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience working in an e-commerce, retail, fulfilment or third-party logistics environment.

• Experience managing high-volume parcel and last-mile operations.

• Knowledge of UK parcel, pallet and freight carrier networks.

• Experience handling dangerous goods or working in a dangerous-goods warehouse environment.

• Knowledge of ADR requirements and dangerous-goods transport documentation.

• Experience with transport management systems, warehouse management systems and carrier portals.

• Experience conducting carrier performance reviews and managing corrective action plans.

• Transport Manager CPC or another relevant logistics qualification would be advantageous but is not essential.

Personal Attributes

• Hands-on, organised and comfortable working in a warehouse environment.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Calm and decisive when managing operational pressure and service failures.

• Clear and confident communicator with both internal teams and external carriers.

• Able to challenge poor performance professionally and drive issues through to resolution.

• Detail-oriented, commercially aware and focused on continuous improvement.

• Capable of working effectively across Chinese and UK business cultures.

Category / Brand Planning: Based on the current status and characteristics of the assigned category/brand, industry trends, platform features, consumer insights, sales data, and business strategy, conduct industry insights, data analysis, iteration, and strategic goal breakdown to plan category structures (e.g., category layout, brand structure, product line structure), formulate category strategies and development plans, and define corresponding growth strategies.

Establish mechanisms for supplier negotiations, rebate and cost management, and regular business reviews. Oversee logistics from supplier to JD warehouses (including delivery timelines, carriers, fulfillment methods, and understanding supplier production bases and warehouse networks). Review and sign annual contracts, and manage after-sales service for supplier products.

Product Operations and Marketing: Based on market competition and brand strategy, manage core product operations such as product listing/removal, availability status, and label creation. Develop and adjust pricing strategies for products within the category. Collaborate with suppliers to optimize product detail pages, store presentation, main images, ad copy, live streaming, and short videos to enhance user experience. Job Description

Job Title: Transport Specialist – Carrier Management

Location: Bedford, UK
Department: Transportation / Supply Chain
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Language Requirement: Fluent English and Mandarin Chinese
Working Arrangement: On-site; flexibility to support operational shifts and peak periods may be required

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Transport Specialist to oversee carrier management and outbound transportation operations at our Bedford warehouse.

The role will coordinate both B2B and B2C outbound shipments, manage day-to-day communication and performance with parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile carriers, and lead a small transportation operations team.

The successful candidate will work closely with the warehouse outbound team to ensure an accurate and controlled handover of goods, timely carrier collections and effective resolution of operational exceptions. This position requires strong transportation knowledge, excellent stakeholder-management skills and the ability to communicate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Key Responsibilities

Transport Operations

• Oversee daily B2B and B2C outbound transportation activities from the Bedford warehouse.

• Plan and coordinate parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile collections according to order volume, service requirements and operational cut-off times.

• Allocate shipments to suitable carriers based on service type, capacity, cost, delivery requirements and operational performance.

• Ensure vehicles and carriers arrive as scheduled and that all shipments are dispatched within the required timeframes.

• Monitor shipment progress and proactively manage collection failures, delays, missed scans, delivery exceptions, damages, losses and returns.

• Support peak-period planning, contingency arrangements and urgent or ad-hoc transport requirements.

Carrier Management

• Act as the main operational contact between the Bedford warehouse and contracted carriers.

• Maintain effective daily communication with carrier account managers, depots, drivers and control teams.

• Conduct regular carrier performance reviews covering on-time collection, on-time delivery, scanning compliance, loss and damage, claims, customer complaints and service failures.

• Escalate recurring issues and drive carriers to provide root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.

• Support carrier onboarding, operational testing, service changes and the implementation of new transport solutions.

• Verify that carriers follow agreed SOPs, service requirements, safety standards and contractual obligations.

• Work with procurement and management teams to support carrier reviews, cost control and continuous improvement.

Warehouse Handover and Dispatch Control

• Work closely with the warehouse outbound team to align picking, packing, staging, loading and carrier collection schedules.

• Establish and maintain a clear handover process between warehouse and transportation teams.

• Confirm shipment quantities, pallet or parcel counts, labels, manifests and supporting documentation before goods are released.

• Ensure all physical handovers and system handovers are properly recorded and traceable.

• Investigate discrepancies between physical goods, system records and carrier collection data.

• Coordinate the safe and efficient loading of vehicles and ensure goods are handed over to the correct carrier.

• Conduct daily reviews of outstanding, uncollected or unsuccessfully dispatched shipments.

Team Leadership

• Lead and coordinate a small transport operations team responsible for dispatch planning, carrier communication and shipment monitoring.

• Allocate daily tasks and ensure appropriate operational coverage throughout the working day.

• Provide training, coaching and operational guidance to team members.

• Monitor team performance and ensure issues are escalated and resolved promptly.

• Maintain clear SOPs, shift handovers and escalation procedures.

• Promote strong collaboration between transportation, warehouse operations, customer service, procurement and other internal teams.

Compliance and Reporting

• Ensure transportation activities comply with company procedures and applicable UK transport, health and safety and security requirements.

• Support compliant handling and transportation of dangerous goods where applicable.

• Maintain accurate transport records, manifests, proof of collection, delivery evidence and exception records.

• Produce daily and weekly reports covering shipment volumes, carrier performance, operational exceptions and outstanding actions.

• Identify operational risks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

• Support internal audits, carrier investigations and customer claims where required.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured against areas including:

• On-time carrier collection

• On-time dispatch and delivery performance

• Successful warehouse-to-carrier handover

• Shipment scanning and tracking compliance

• Loss, damage and claims performance

• Transport exception closure time

• Carrier capacity fulfilment

• Customer complaint levels

• Transport cost and operational efficiency

• Team productivity and SOP compliance

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience in transportation, carrier management, dispatch or logistics operations.

• Practical experience managing B2B and B2C outbound shipments.

• Experience working directly with parcel carriers, pallet networks, freight providers or last-mile delivery companies.

• Previous experience leading, supervising or coordinating a small operational team.

• Strong understanding of warehouse dispatch, shipment handover and carrier collection processes.

• Ability to manage multiple carriers, priorities and operational exceptions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and escalation-management skills.

• Confident user of transportation, warehouse or carrier-management systems.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.

• Fluent spoken and written English and Mandarin Chinese.

• Eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience working in an e-commerce, retail, fulfilment or third-party logistics environment.

• Experience managing high-volume parcel and last-mile operations.

• Knowledge of UK parcel, pallet and freight carrier networks.

• Experience handling dangerous goods or working in a dangerous-goods warehouse environment.

• Knowledge of ADR requirements and dangerous-goods transport documentation.

• Experience with transport management systems, warehouse management systems and carrier portals.

• Experience conducting carrier performance reviews and managing corrective action plans.

• Transport Manager CPC or another relevant logistics qualification would be advantageous but is not essential.

Personal Attributes

• Hands-on, organised and comfortable working in a warehouse environment.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Calm and decisive when managing operational pressure and service failures.

• Clear and confident communicator with both internal teams and external carriers.

• Able to challenge poor performance professionally and drive issues through to resolution.

• Detail-oriented, commercially aware and focused on continuous improvement.

• Capable of working effectively across Chinese and UK business cultures.

Category / Brand Planning: Based on the current status and characteristics of the assigned category/brand, industry trends, platform features, consumer insights, sales data, and business strategy, conduct industry insights, data analysis, iteration, and strategic goal breakdown to plan category structures (e.g., category layout, brand structure, product line structure), formulate category strategies and development plans, and define corresponding growth strategies.

Working Arrangement: On-site; flexibility to support operational shifts and peak periods may be required

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Transport Specialist to oversee carrier management and outbound transportation operations at our Bedford warehouse.

The role will coordinate both B2B and B2C outbound shipments, manage day-to-day communication and performance with parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile carriers, and lead a small transportation operations team.

The successful candidate will work closely with the warehouse outbound team to ensure an accurate and controlled handover of goods, timely carrier collections and effective resolution of operational exceptions. This position requires strong transportation knowledge, excellent stakeholder-management skills and the ability to communicate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Key Responsibilities

Transport Operations

• Oversee daily B2B and B2C outbound transportation activities from the Bedford warehouse.

• Plan and coordinate parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile collections according to order volume, service requirements and operational cut-off times.

• Allocate shipments to suitable carriers based on service type, capacity, cost, delivery requirements and operational performance.

• Ensure vehicles and carriers arrive as scheduled and that all shipments are dispatched within the required timeframes.

• Monitor shipment progress and proactively manage collection failures, delays, missed scans, delivery exceptions, damages, losses and returns.

• Support peak-period planning, contingency arrangements and urgent or ad-hoc transport requirements.

Carrier Management

• Act as the main operational contact between the Bedford warehouse and contracted carriers.

• Maintain effective daily communication with carrier account managers, depots, drivers and control teams.

• Conduct regular carrier performance reviews covering on-time collection, on-time delivery, scanning compliance, loss and damage, claims, customer complaints and service failures.

• Escalate recurring issues and drive carriers to provide root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.

• Support carrier onboarding, operational testing, service changes and the implementation of new transport solutions.

• Verify that carriers follow agreed SOPs, service requirements, safety standards and contractual obligations.

• Work with procurement and management teams to support carrier reviews, cost control and continuous improvement.

Warehouse Handover and Dispatch Control

• Work closely with the warehouse outbound team to align picking, packing, staging, loading and carrier collection schedules.

• Establish and maintain a clear handover process between warehouse and transportation teams.

• Confirm shipment quantities, pallet or parcel counts, labels, manifests and supporting documentation before goods are released.

• Ensure all physical handovers and system handovers are properly recorded and traceable.

• Investigate discrepancies between physical goods, system records and carrier collection data.

• Coordinate the safe and efficient loading of vehicles and ensure goods are handed over to the correct carrier.

• Conduct daily reviews of outstanding, uncollected or unsuccessfully dispatched shipments.

Team Leadership

• Lead and coordinate a small transport operations team responsible for dispatch planning, carrier communication and shipment monitoring.

• Allocate daily tasks and ensure appropriate operational coverage throughout the working day.

• Provide training, coaching and operational guidance to team members.

• Monitor team performance and ensure issues are escalated and resolved promptly.

• Maintain clear SOPs, shift handovers and escalation procedures.

• Promote strong collaboration between transportation, warehouse operations, customer service, procurement and other internal teams.

Compliance and Reporting

• Ensure transportation activities comply with company procedures and applicable UK transport, health and safety and security requirements.

• Support compliant handling and transportation of dangerous goods where applicable.

• Maintain accurate transport records, manifests, proof of collection, delivery evidence and exception records.

• Produce daily and weekly reports covering shipment volumes, carrier performance, operational exceptions and outstanding actions.

• Identify operational risks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

• Support internal audits, carrier investigations and customer claims where required.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured against areas including:

• On-time carrier collection

• On-time dispatch and delivery performance

• Successful warehouse-to-carrier handover

• Shipment scanning and tracking compliance

• Loss, damage and claims performance

• Transport exception closure time

• Carrier capacity fulfilment

• Customer complaint levels

• Transport cost and operational efficiency

• Team productivity and SOP compliance

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience in transportation, carrier management, dispatch or logistics operations.

• Practical experience managing B2B and B2C outbound shipments.

• Experience working directly with parcel carriers, pallet networks, freight providers or last-mile delivery companies.

• Previous experience leading, supervising or coordinating a small operational team.

• Strong understanding of warehouse dispatch, shipment handover and carrier collection processes.

• Ability to manage multiple carriers, priorities and operational exceptions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and escalation-management skills.

• Confident user of transportation, warehouse or carrier-management systems.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.

• Fluent spoken and written English and Mandarin Chinese.

• Eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience working in an e-commerce, retail, fulfilment or third-party logistics environment.

• Experience managing high-volume parcel and last-mile operations.

• Knowledge of UK parcel, pallet and freight carrier networks.

• Experience handling dangerous goods or working in a dangerous-goods warehouse environment.

Job Description

Job Title: Transport Specialist – Carrier Management

Location: Bedford, UK
Department: Transportation / Supply Chain
Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent
Language Requirement: Fluent English and Mandarin Chinese
Working Arrangement: On-site; flexibility to support operational shifts and peak periods may be required

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Transport Specialist to oversee carrier management and outbound transportation operations at our Bedford warehouse.

The role will coordinate both B2B and B2C outbound shipments, manage day-to-day communication and performance with parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile carriers, and lead a small transportation operations team.

The successful candidate will work closely with the warehouse outbound team to ensure an accurate and controlled handover of goods, timely carrier collections and effective resolution of operational exceptions. This position requires strong transportation knowledge, excellent stakeholder-management skills and the ability to communicate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Key Responsibilities

Transport Operations

• Oversee daily B2B and B2C outbound transportation activities from the Bedford warehouse.

• Plan and coordinate parcel, pallet, freight and last-mile collections according to order volume, service requirements and operational cut-off times.

• Allocate shipments to suitable carriers based on service type, capacity, cost, delivery requirements and operational performance.

• Ensure vehicles and carriers arrive as scheduled and that all shipments are dispatched within the required timeframes.

• Monitor shipment progress and proactively manage collection failures, delays, missed scans, delivery exceptions, damages, losses and returns.

• Support peak-period planning, contingency arrangements and urgent or ad-hoc transport requirements.

Carrier Management

• Act as the main operational contact between the Bedford warehouse and contracted carriers.

• Maintain effective daily communication with carrier account managers, depots, drivers and control teams.

• Conduct regular carrier performance reviews covering on-time collection, on-time delivery, scanning compliance, loss and damage, claims, customer complaints and service failures.

• Escalate recurring issues and drive carriers to provide root-cause analysis and corrective action plans.

• Support carrier onboarding, operational testing, service changes and the implementation of new transport solutions.

• Verify that carriers follow agreed SOPs, service requirements, safety standards and contractual obligations.

• Work with procurement and management teams to support carrier reviews, cost control and continuous improvement.

Warehouse Handover and Dispatch Control

• Work closely with the warehouse outbound team to align picking, packing, staging, loading and carrier collection schedules.

• Establish and maintain a clear handover process between warehouse and transportation teams.

• Confirm shipment quantities, pallet or parcel counts, labels, manifests and supporting documentation before goods are released.

• Ensure all physical handovers and system handovers are properly recorded and traceable.

• Investigate discrepancies between physical goods, system records and carrier collection data.

• Coordinate the safe and efficient loading of vehicles and ensure goods are handed over to the correct carrier.

• Conduct daily reviews of outstanding, uncollected or unsuccessfully dispatched shipments.

Team Leadership

• Lead and coordinate a small transport operations team responsible for dispatch planning, carrier communication and shipment monitoring.

• Allocate daily tasks and ensure appropriate operational coverage throughout the working day.

• Provide training, coaching and operational guidance to team members.

• Monitor team performance and ensure issues are escalated and resolved promptly.

• Maintain clear SOPs, shift handovers and escalation procedures.

• Promote strong collaboration between transportation, warehouse operations, customer service, procurement and other internal teams.

Compliance and Reporting

• Ensure transportation activities comply with company procedures and applicable UK transport, health and safety and security requirements.

• Support compliant handling and transportation of dangerous goods where applicable.

• Maintain accurate transport records, manifests, proof of collection, delivery evidence and exception records.

• Produce daily and weekly reports covering shipment volumes, carrier performance, operational exceptions and outstanding actions.

• Identify operational risks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

• Support internal audits, carrier investigations and customer claims where required.

Key Performance Indicators

The role will be measured against areas including:

• On-time carrier collection

• On-time dispatch and delivery performance

• Successful warehouse-to-carrier handover

• Shipment scanning and tracking compliance

• Loss, damage and claims performance

• Transport exception closure time

• Carrier capacity fulfilment

• Customer complaint levels

• Transport cost and operational efficiency

• Team productivity and SOP compliance

Essential Requirements

• Proven experience in transportation, carrier management, dispatch or logistics operations.

• Practical experience managing B2B and B2C outbound shipments.

• Experience working directly with parcel carriers, pallet networks, freight providers or last-mile delivery companies.

• Previous experience leading, supervising or coordinating a small operational team.

• Strong understanding of warehouse dispatch, shipment handover and carrier collection processes.

• Ability to manage multiple carriers, priorities and operational exceptions in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and escalation-management skills.

• Confident user of transportation, warehouse or carrier-management systems.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.

• Fluent spoken and written English and Mandarin Chinese.

• Eligible to work in the United Kingdom.

Desirable Requirements

• Experience working in an e-commerce, retail, fulfilment or third-party logistics environment.

• Experience managing high-volume parcel and last-mile operations.

• Knowledge of UK parcel, pallet and freight carrier networks.

• Experience handling dangerous goods or working in a dangerous-goods warehouse environment.

• Knowledge of ADR requirements and dangerous-goods transport documentation.

• Experience with transport management systems, warehouse management systems and carrier portals.

• Experience conducting carrier performance reviews and managing corrective action plans.

• Transport Manager CPC or another relevant logistics qualification would be advantageous but is not essential.

Personal Attributes

• Hands-on, organised and comfortable working in a warehouse environment.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Calm and decisive when managing operational pressure and service failures.

• Clear and confident communicator with both internal teams and external carriers.

• Able to challenge poor performance professionally and drive issues through to resolution.

• Detail-oriented, commercially aware and focused on continuous improvement.

• Capable of working effectively across Chinese and UK business cultures.

• Good understanding of consumer electronics hardware, product functionality and basic fault diagnosis.

• Ability to identify signs of tampering, component replacement, product substitution, missing parts and other abnormalities.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Job Summary

As a Maintenance Technician at JD.com, Inc., you will be responsible for the upkeep, repair, and preventative maintenance of our facilities, equipment, and machinery, ensuring smooth and efficient operations across our logistics and fulfillment centers.

Job Responsibilities**

* Perform routine inspections and preventative maintenance on various mechanical, electrical, and HVAC systems.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot equipment malfunctions, electrical issues, and structural problems.
* Execute repairs on conveyor systems, forklifts, packaging machinery, and other warehouse equipment.
* Conduct minor plumbing and carpentry tasks as needed.
* Respond promptly to maintenance requests and emergency breakdowns.
* Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, repairs, and parts inventory.
* Adhere to all safety regulations and company policies, promoting a safe working environment.
* Collaborate with other technicians and departments to ensure operational efficiency.
* Identify and recommend improvements to equipment and maintenance procedures.
* Assist in the installation and commissioning of new equipment.

Job Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent; vocational training or certification in a relevant technical field (e.g., HVAC, industrial maintenance, electrical) preferred.
* Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in industrial maintenance, facilities maintenance, or a similar role.
* Proficiency in troubleshooting and repairing mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic systems.
* Strong understanding of safety protocols and practices in a warehouse or industrial setting.
* Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, blueprints, and schematics.
* Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) is a plus.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Physical ability to lift heavy objects, climb ladders, and work in various environments (e.g., hot, cold, dusty).
* Flexibility to work shifts, including nights and weekends, as required.

Role Overview

Working within the Big & Bulky network and the Delivery Station team, the B&B Delivery Operation Supervisor will provide the leadership to ensure that a great customer experience is delivered safely and efficiently. Collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders to engage the team to maintain great standards.

Key Responsibilities

• Line management responsibilities for the JD drivers and installers – recruitment, training, scheduling, holiday management, disciplinary, development planning – working with the Installations Technical Team for training support and to identify trends

• Contract management responsibility for the DSP installations crews

• Ensuring that the delivery routing is carried out to deliver a safe plan to meet the customer promise and operating SOPs, making sure that the crews are assigned to the tasks aligned to their qualification and engaging with DSPs to flex the capacity of the delivery crews to maintain efficiency

• Ensure that the receipt of the inbound orders, loading out on to the delivery vehicles, return of reverse orders and dispatch to the central warehouse are carried out safely, efficiently and in line with the SOP

• Ensure that the appropriate vehicle checks and maintenance processes, including driving license checks and fuel card management, are completed and records kept

• Manage the delivery/installation teams when they are out on the road, advise on decisions they are taking and seek advice from the Installations Technical Team to allow the best customer service with the minimum risk to delivery timeliness for other customers, H&S for customer and crew, and risk of damage to product or customer homes

• Investigate issues (customer complaints, accidents, vehicle/product damage, KPI misses) in a prompt manner, communicating clearly with all stakeholders and putting steps in place to improve performance going forward

• Management of the tools and consumables for the JD and DSP crews, conduct inventory checks and request replenishment as needed

Key Skills/Experience

• Great leadership/engagement of teams who operate away from the Delivery Station

• Customer focus, using the SOPs to make practical decisions to prioritise meeting the customers’ needs

• Collaboration within the Delivery Station and within the B&B network, working with internal and external stakeholders

• Strong operational skills and a good ability to prioritise

• Strong communication skills, with internal and external colleagues and especially with customers

• Preferable to have experience of final mile, big & bulky operations, and/or installations

Key Relationships

• Customers

• Own team

• DSPs

• Delivery Station team

JDL Last Mile Cluster Manager

This role can be based in Edinburgh, Glasgow or Newcastle

Scope

The cluster manager role in JDL last mile operations has oversight for multiple depots within a defined geographical area.  The role holder has full responsibility and accountability for on-site coverage for People, Safety, Performance and Quality across those depots.  The role reports into the Director for Last Mile Operations.

Job Responsibilities:

Cluster Operational Ownership: Hold full responsibility and accountability for a geographically defined cluster of delivery stations, ensuring full on-site coverage across all stations in scope. People, Safety, Performance and Quality: Own the four core pillars across every station in the cluster. Build and develop high-performing site teams, ensure safety, security, and compliance standards at all locations, and drive consistent performance and quality outcomes for the cluster of delivery stations. Operations and Staff Planning: Direct day-to-day operations across the cluster, including resource allocation, shift and staff planning, and capacity management, adapting coverage to meet fluctuating volume and changing operational demands across multiple sites. Escalation Management: Act as the primary escalation point for all delivery stations within scope, resolving operational, service, and people issues promptly and routing strategic or cross-functional matters to the appropriate country or regional function. Partner Performance Management: Manage Partner performance with the Partner Country Manager and the country/regional lead, using KPIs and structured reviews to hold partners accountable for delivery quality, timeliness, and compliance across the cluster.

Job Requirements:

Basic Requirements: Bachelor's degree or above, in Logistics, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field. Language Requirement: Fluent in English as a working language for briefings, reporting, and cross-functional communication. Additional regional languages are an advantage given the multi-site, multi-market nature of the cluster. Work Experience: 5+ years of experience in logistics or warehouse operations, ideally including last-mile delivery, with proven experience managing multiple sites or a multi-team operation in a fast-paced environment. Professional Competence: Strong people leadership with a track record of recruiting, training, developing, and managing diverse teams across locations. Data-driven mindset with demonstrated use of KPIs to guide operational decisions, and proficiency in logistics systems and Microsoft Office tools. Soft Skills: Proactive, hands-on leader with strong communication and coaching abilities. Capable of cross-functional coordination with transport, HR, and customer service teams, comfortable with regular travel between cluster sites, and able to maintain operational consistency across a dispersed footprint.

Desirable Experience:

Background in e-commerce, courier, or delivery service operations. Direct experience managing Partners and performance framework. Familiarity with delivery management platforms and routing optimisation tools.

Job Summary:**
