description:
Who We Are

At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line-haul transportation, last-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.

Our Global Reach

JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Today, we operate 130+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

What We Offer

Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

The Role
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Operations Support professional to join our team. This role is essential in supporting labour operations by coordinating staffing administration, attendance management, timesheet verification, and labour cost settlement. The position requires strong communication skills to effectively liaise between supervisors, HR teams, service providers, and employees. Attention to detail and bilingual communication (English and Chinese) are critical to ensure accurate workforce records and smooth daily operations.

Key Responsibilities

• Support labour personnel administration including recruitment requests, staff replacement coordination, and offboarding processes.
• Maintain personnel records by managing account creation, system access, and scheduling setup or adjustments.
• Provide on-site onboarding support, including assisting new staff with system registration and facial recognition enrollment.
• Monitor and manage attendance records, handling attendance exceptions and adjusting system work hours where necessary.
• Prepare and maintain employee timesheets to ensure accurate recording of working hours.
• Review and reconcile working hours, communicating with supervisors to confirm missing or inconsistent records.
• Coordinate labour cost settlement by receiving, consolidating, and reviewing supplier invoices.
• Follow up on invoice discrepancies through work hour verification and cross-team communication.
• Support bills management including coordination, documentation, and settlement processes.
• Maintain accurate operational records and ensure documentation is properly organized and tracked.

What We're Looking For

• Experience: 2+ years in operations support, workforce coordination, HR administration, or a related role.
• Skills: Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, with experience using workforce management or scheduling systems.

• Language: Excellent written and spoken English and Chinese, with the ability to communicate clearly with both internal teams and external service providers.
• Communication: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to coordinate effectively across departments and resolve issues efficiently.
• Mindset: Proactive, reliable, and capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced operational environment.

Desirable Qualifications:

• Experience supporting warehouse, logistics, or labour service provider operations.
• Familiarity with attendance tracking systems or workforce management platforms.
• Experience with invoice reconciliation or labour cost tracking.

title: Payment Operations & Risk Analyst
description:
Who We Are

Joybuy is JD.com’s dedicated retail platform for Europe, offering products across a wide range of categories. Operating across the UK, Netherlands, Germany, France, Belgium and Luxembourg, we’re building the future of retail through smart systems, bold ideas, and a customer-first mindset. Backed by JD.com, also known as JINGDONG, and its trusted global technology and supply chain ecosystem, we deliver a shopping experience that is speedy, reliable, and genuinely enjoyable. If you’re ready to make a difference, bring your talent and grow with us. Don’t just buy, Joybuy.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://about.joybuy.com/about/

What We Offer

Joining Joybuy means becoming part of a business where people, innovation, and impact work together to shape the future of cross-border e-commerce. You’ll contribute to smart supply chains, efficient logistics, and meaningful projects that drive real customer value. With a competitive salary, great office locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to grow your career, learn from talented colleagues, and make a genuine impact in a fast-expanding international business.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the Joybuy team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

We are seeking a data-driven and analytical Payment Operations & Risk Analyst to monitor, optimize, and protect our global payment ecosystem. In this role, you will be the frontline investigator tracking payment performance, mitigating fraud, and identifying areas to improve cost efficiency. You will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Risk teams, translating complex transaction data into actionable improvements that safeguard company funds and enhance customer experience. If you love solving data puzzles, mapping out technical user journeys, and supporting international scaling, this role is for you.

What you will do:

•
Order & Payment Scheme Design and Implementation
Focus on the full-chain of cross-border e-commerce order transactions; lead the business solution design for platform transaction payments, order settlement, and receivables/collection disbursement.
Deeply adapt to cross-border platform trading rules; deliver standardized transaction payment & settlement solutions tailored to different merchants, transaction scenarios and order types, supporting the scaled and standardized expansion of platform order transaction business.

•
Transaction Payment System Requirements & Development
Deeply participate in iterative development and functional optimization of the order transaction payment system; focus on core transaction payment scenarios.
Take charge of business-side requirements research, transaction link flow mapping, and payment process design; independently output business solutions and collaborate with product, R&D and risk control teams to deliver core capabilities.

•
Payment Service & Process Optimization
Continuously review and address pain points across the end-to-end order transaction payment chain.
Run dedicated optimization initiatives targeting key issues, including transaction payment failures, abnormal order settlement, delayed collection, stuck funds, transaction rejections, and compensation/dispute handling.
Iterate on the transaction payment operational processes to drive up the overall order transaction success rate.

•
Cross-departmental Project Execution
Coordinate with business, operations, risk control and technical teams to drive dedicated optimization projects for order transaction payment and settlement.
Follow the full lifecycle of requirements review, system development, feature testing, pilot (gray) launch, acceptance and iteration to ensure the payment system capability matches the platform's order transaction business growth rhythm.

•
Transaction Data Review & Best-practice Accumulation
Own monitoring and control of core payment data metrics, including transaction success rate, settlement timeliness, and abnormal transactions ratio.
Complete issue attribution and performance review; issue regular transaction payment analysis reports.
Accumulate standardized cross-border order transaction payment solutions, risk handling case studies chers, and best practices.

About you:

•
Experience: 2-5 years of experience in payment operations, data analytics, fraud risk management, or a closely related role within fintech or e-commerce.

•

Build the core risk governance and risk decisions foundation of a growing platform

Design AI-native decision systems from the ground up

•
Directly impact fraud prevention, user trust, and platform integrity at scale

Work on complex, high-impact problems at the intersection of AI, systems, and real-world risk

Risk Strategy | Decision Systems | Fraud Prevention | AI and ML Signals | Rule Engines | Threshold Optimization | Data Analysis | System Design | Cross-functional Execution | Marketplace Risk

• Take overall responsibility for the daily operation and management of the Dangerous Goods Warehouse, ensuring safe, compliant, efficient, and stable operations.

• Manage warehouse operational teams and team leaders, and coordinate activities across inbound, inventory, outbound, and other operational functions.

• Ensure full compliance with dangerous goods warehousing and safety requirements, including product classification, labeling, segregation and storage, SDS/FDS documentation, UN classification, CLP requirements, and related operating procedures.

• Coordinate closely with the DGSA (Dangerous Goods Safety Adviser / ADR Manager) regarding dangerous goods quantities, storage and handling standards, and applicable ADR requirements.

• Manage workforce planning, staffing, shift scheduling, training, and team performance.

• Organize and coordinate all mandatory training required for employees involved in dangerous goods operations, ensuring training records and qualifications remain valid and up to date.

• Identify operational, compliance, and safety risks, and lead the handling of incidents, operational exceptions, accidents, and emergency situations.

• Coordinate with Transportation, Quality, QI/EHS, Supply Chain, and other relevant departments to resolve cross-functional operational issues.

• Continuously optimize warehouse layout, operational processes, resource allocation, standard operating procedures, and overall warehouse management standards.

• Promote a strong safety and compliance culture across the warehouse and ensure operational practices comply with internal requirements and applicable regulations.

Candidate Profile / Requirements

• 3–5+ years of warehouse management experience, with dangerous goods warehouse management experience strongly preferred / required.

• Proven experience managing a relatively large warehouse operation and operational teams, with the ability to oversee multiple warehouse functions.

• Strong knowledge of dangerous goods warehousing, safety requirements, and relevant regulations and standards, including ADR, SDS/FDS, UN classification, and CLP.

• Experience working in an ICPE-regulated environment is highly preferred.

• Experience coordinating with a DGSA / ADR Manager is preferred.

• Strong people management, operational management, data analysis, risk management, and cross-functional coordination skills.

• Strong awareness of warehouse safety, compliance, incident prevention, and emergency response.

• Ability to analyze operational KPIs and drive productivity, quality, safety, and cost improvements.

• Good working English, with the ability to communicate effectively in daily business situations.

Fluency in Chinese, English, and French is required for daily communication, team management, and cross-functional coordination.

With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Job Summary:**

JD.com, Inc. is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Bulky Warehouse Manager to oversee all aspects of our large item warehousing operations. This role is crucial for ensuring efficient storage, handling, and distribution of bulky goods, optimizing processes, and leading a high-performing team.

Job Responsibilities:**

* Manage the day-to-day operations of the bulky goods warehouse, including receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, and dispatch of large and irregularly shaped items.
* Develop and implement efficient warehouse layouts, material handling procedures, and inventory management strategies specifically tailored for bulky goods.
* Optimize space utilization and minimize damage to bulky items through proper storage techniques and equipment usage.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of warehouse staff, including supervisors, forklift operators, and manual handlers, ensuring adherence to safety protocols and productivity targets.
* Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as receiving efficiency, storage accuracy, picking rates, and shipping timeliness, implementing corrective actions as needed.
* Ensure compliance with all safety regulations, company policies, and industry standards related to warehouse operations and bulky item handling.
* Collaborate with transportation, inventory, and customer service departments to streamline the end-to-end supply chain for bulky products.
* Manage warehouse equipment maintenance schedules and ensure optimal functionality of forklifts, pallet jacks, and other heavy lifting machinery.
* Implement and manage warehouse management systems (WMS) and other relevant technologies to improve operational efficiency and data accuracy.
* Conduct regular audits of inventory and processes to identify areas for improvement and implement best practices.

Job Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5-7 years of progressive experience in warehouse management, with at least 3 years specifically managing operations involving bulky or large items.
* Proven track record of successfully optimizing warehouse processes, improving efficiency, and reducing operational costs.
* Strong leadership and team management skills with the ability to motivate, train, and develop a diverse workforce.
* In-depth knowledge of warehouse management systems (WMS) and other inventory control software.
* Expertise in material handling equipment (e.g., forklifts, reach trucks) operation and safety regulations.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Proficiency in English; knowledge of Mandarin Chinese is a plus.

At JINGDONG Logistics, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Sorting Chef d'Equipe
description:
Qui nous sommes

JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics) est la branche logistique de JD.com et l’un des principaux acteurs mondiaux des solutions supply-chain pilotées par la technologie. Forts d’une expertise avancée en automatisation, en gestion intelligente des flux et en analyse de données, nous opérons des services logistiques intégrés de bout en bout qui accompagnent les entreprises dans leur croissance et améliorent l’expérience client.

Nos réseaux couvrent l’ensemble de la chaîne logistique : gestion d’entrepôts, transport longue distance, livraison du dernier kilomètre, logistique des produits volumineux, chaîne du froid et opérations transfrontalières. Notre ambition : garantir vitesse, fiabilité et précision à chaque étape.

Notre présence internationale

JINGDONG Logistics a construit sur l’une des infrastructures logistiques les plus étendues au monde, avec plus de 3 600 entrepôts totalisant 34 millions de mètres carrés. Notre réseau international de logistique intelligente allie entrepôts hautement automatisés et solutions de transport international robustes, pour fluidifier les flux transfrontaliers.

Aujourd’hui, nous exploitons plus de 130 entrepôts (sous douane, en envoi direct ou à l'étranger) dans 23 pays et régions, à travers nos marques internationales JoyLogistics et JoyExpress — en pleine expansion pour renforcer l’empreinte logistique mondiale de JD.com.

En savoir plus sur qui nous sommes et ce que nous faisons : https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

Ce que nous offrons

Rejoindre JD Logistics, c’est contribuer activement à construire l’avenir de la supply-chain et de la logistique à l’échelle mondiale. Vous travaillerez sur des projets concrets autour des entrepôts intelligents, de la livraison autonome et des technologies innovantes qui font circuler les marchandises à travers le monde.

Nous proposons une rémunération compétitive, des locaux idéalement situés, et une culture d’entreprise centrée sur l’humain. Vous aurez l’opportunité de relever des défis stimulants, de développer vos compétences, et de faire une vraie différence dans un secteur en pleine transformation.

À propos de l’équipe

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe JD Logistics, où l’on valorise le travail d’équipe, la prise d’initiatives et l’engagement à délivrer des résultats de qualité dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant.

Répartition des tâches et planification du personnel : Élaborer des plans de tri adaptés en fonction du volume de marchandises et des objectifs de délai. Répartir rationnellement les tâches entre les membres de l’équipe, coordonner l’utilisation des équipements, assurer le bon déroulement des opérations de tri et garantir que les marchandises soient triées et expédiées dans les délais prévus.

Supervision et optimisation des processus : Superviser l’exécution des opérations de tri, contrôler le respect des procédures et des standards opérationnels, et corriger rapidement tout écart constaté. Analyser les goulots d’étranglement, optimiser les parcours et les méthodes de tri, promouvoir la standardisation des processus et améliorer l’efficacité globale des opérations.

Gestion des anomalies et contrôle qualité : Traiter les anomalies rencontrées pendant les opérations de tri, notamment les marchandises endommagées ou les erreurs de tri, assurer un retour d’information rapide et coordonner la mise en place de solutions adaptées. Réaliser des contrôles aléatoires et des vérifications de la qualité du tri afin de garantir l’exactitude des opérations et de réduire le taux d’erreur.

Management et formation de l’équipe : Assurer la gestion quotidienne de l’équipe de tri, organiser des sessions de formation afin d’améliorer les compétences opérationnelles et la sensibilisation à la sécurité. Suivre l’état de travail et la performance des membres de l’équipe, favoriser un environnement de travail positif et renforcer la cohésion ainsi que la capacité d’exécution de l’équipe.

Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de chargement/déchargement, de transport et les autres fonctions opérationnelles afin d’assurer une transmission fluide des marchandises. Communiquer rapidement les informations pertinentes, résoudre conjointement les problèmes d’interface entre le tri et les autres étapes opérationnelles, et garantir la fluidité et l’efficacité de l’ensemble du flux logistique.

JINGDONG Logistics s'engage à favoriser un environnement de travail inclusif, dans lequel chacun et chacune peut s’épanouir pleinement. Nous sommes fiers d’être un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. Toutes nos décisions en matière d’emploi sont prises sans distinction d’origine, de sexe, d’identité de genre, d’orientation sexuelle, d’âge, de situation de handicap, de religion, d’opinions ou de toute autre caractéristique sans lien avec les aptitudes professionnelles.

Prêt(e) à postuler ?

Passez à l’étape suivante de votre carrière, postulez dès maintenant et découvrez les opportunités que nous avons à offrir.

Job Summary

The Installation Operation Specialist at JD.com, Inc. is responsible for the efficient and accurate setup, configuration, and maintenance of various equipment and systems to support our logistics and operational infrastructure.

This is a key operational role within a growing installation business. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring high-quality installation standards, technical compliance and service delivery, while supporting the development of our installer network and operational processes.

Initially, the role will have a strong focus on establishing installation standards, auditing, technical support, training and operational capability. As the operation grows, the role will oversee expanding installation teams across multiple UK locations.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the day-to-day operational and technical management of Electrical and EV installation services.

• Ensure all installation work meets relevant UK electrical regulations, safety requirements and internal quality standards.

• Audit completed and ongoing installations to maintain high standards of workmanship and customer service.

• Provide technical guidance and remedial support for complex installation issues.

• Develop installation SOPs, quality standards, technical guidance and compliance processes.

• Support the recruitment, assessment and onboarding of qualified electrical and EV installers.

• Deliver or coordinate technical training and competency assessments for installation teams.

• Monitor installer performance, installation quality, compliance and customer service levels.

• Support the development of the EV charging installation operation, including relevant OZEV and MCS requirements.

• Work closely with Operations, Quality, Customer Service and HR teams to continuously improve installation performance.

• Support the expansion of installation operations from Luton into Manchester, Croydon, Bristol and other UK locations.

Essential Requirements

• Level 3 NVQ qualification in Electrical Installation or equivalent.

• Valid ECS Gold Card.

• AM2 qualification.

• Relevant EV Charger Installation qualification(s).

• Strong practical experience in domestic and/or commercial electrical installation.

• Strong understanding of UK electrical regulations and safe working practices.

• Previous experience supervising, managing or technically supporting electrical installers.

• Experience conducting installation audits, quality inspections and remedial works.

• Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills.

• Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel when required.

Desirable Requirements

• Good understanding of OZEV requirements and approved EV charging schemes.

• Knowledge or practical experience of MCS standards and certification requirements.

• Previous experience within home installation, last-mile installation, EV charging or field-service operations.

• Experience developing or delivering installer training.

• Experience supporting recruitment or technical interviews for installation engineers.

• Experience building or scaling a new installation operation would be advantageous.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who combines strong hands-on technical knowledge with operational leadership. The successful candidate should be comfortable establishing processes in a start-up environment, maintaining high installation standards and developing teams as the business grows.

title: Risk Control
description:
Who We Are

At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line-haul transportation, last-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.

Our Global Reach

JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Today, we operate 130+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

What We Offer

Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

1. Risk Control Framework Development
Analyze business workflows and requirements to design risk management frameworks and tools (e.g., AML systems, sanctions screening). Standardize risk governance practices and ensure alignment with evolving business objectives.
2. Strategy Development & Optimization
Monitor risk patterns and illicit activity trends to develop anti-fraud/anti-arbitrage strategies. Continuously refine approaches to balance growth objectives with risk mitigation, minimizing losses from external threats.
3. Risk Monitoring & Analytics
Develop risk models and monitoring frameworks (e.g., logistics analytics, suspicious transaction alerts). Analyze key metric anomalies, identify root causes, and deliver actionable solutions to drive remediation.
4. Compliance & AML Governance
Execute AML compliance activities including customer due diligence, sanctions screening, and large-value transaction reporting. Streamline compliance workflows to ensure adherence to regulations across jurisdictions (e.g., Hong Kong, U.S.), mitigating legal exposure.
5. System & Process Enhancement
Drive iterative enhancements to risk systems (e.g., automated reviews, risk profiling). Integrate multi-source data (e.g., shipping documents, tracking data, corporate registries) to refine operational workflows and enhance risk management precision.
6. Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to execute risk mitigation strategies and resolve operational bottlenecks. Conduct training programs and case studies to strengthen organizational risk awareness and foster a company-wide risk-aware culture.

Présentation du poste

Dans le cadre de nos activités logistiques, nous recherchons un(e) Opérateur(trice) Gestion des anomalies retours. Vous serez chargé(e) d’identifier, d’analyser et de résoudre les anomalies liées aux colis retournés et à leur réception en entrepôt.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de l’entrepôt, de préparation de commandes, de transport, de distribution et du service client afin de garantir un traitement rapide et fiable des dossiers.

Vos principales missions

•
Prendre en charge les colis retournés présentant une anomalie et coordonner leur traitement avec les différentes équipes concernées.

•
Analyser les problèmes opérationnels et participer à leur résolution avec les équipes de l’entrepôt, du transport, de la distribution et du service client.

•
Assurer le suivi des dossiers en attente liés aux anomalies de réception et y apporter une réponse dans les délais impartis.

•
Accompagner les opérateurs de l’entrepôt dans la résolution des anomalies de réception et des problèmes liés aux systèmes informatiques.

•
Effectuer le rapprochement des stocks pour les marchandises présentant une anomalie.

•
Analyser les écarts de stock, notamment les excédents et les pertes, en identifier les causes et contribuer à leur régularisation.

•
Créer, actualiser et assurer le suivi des rapports d’anomalies.

•
Analyser les données opérationnelles et communiquer régulièrement sur l’avancement des dossiers en cours.

•
H/F, de niveau Bac+2 en logistique ou équivalent,
Bonne maîtrise de Microsoft Excel, notamment des fonctionnalités suivantes :

•
fonctions RECHERCHE V et RECHERCHE X (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP) ;

•
tableaux croisés dynamiques ;

•
filtres et tris ;

•
mise en forme conditionnelle ;

•
formules SI, SOMME.SI et SOMME.SI.ENS (IF, SUMIF et SUMIFS).

•
Capacité à comparer, rapprocher, contrôler et valider efficacement d’importants volumes de données.

•
Aisance avec les outils informatiques et capacité à prendre rapidement en main un logiciel de gestion d’entrepôt (WMS).

•
Niveau d’anglais permettant de communiquer simplement, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

•
Rigueur, sens du détail et bonnes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.

•
Capacité à travailler sous pression dans un environnement logistique dynamique.

•
Bon relationnel et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec différentes équipes.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Food Safety Specialist

Location – Milton Keynes

Job Purpose

The Food Safety Specialist is responsible for ensuring that all food storage, handling and transport activities across the organisation’s distribution centres and transport operations meet the highest food safety standards and comply with all relevant regulatory and customer requirements.

The role will lead the development, implementation and maintenance of food safety systems including HACCP, food hygiene standards and audit programmes, ensuring safe and compliant handling of food products throughout the logistics network.

Key Responsibilities

Food Safety Management

• Lead the implementation and maintenance of food safety management systems across the business.

• Ensure all sites operate in accordance with recognised food safety standards and company policies.

Auditing & Inspections

• Conduct routine internal food safety audits and hygiene inspections across all logistics sites.

• Identify gaps and implement corrective and preventative actions.

• Monitor compliance with temperature control, traceability and product handling requirements.

Incident & Risk Management

• Lead investigations into food safety incidents, contamination risks or product integrity issues.

• Manage product hold, quarantine and recall procedures when required.

• Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

Transport & Cold Chain Integrity

• Ensure effective control of temperature-controlled storage and transport where applicable.

• Work with Transport Managers to ensure vehicles meet hygiene and food safety standards.

•

Training & Engagement

• Deliver food safety training programmes to operational teams including warehouse staff, drivers and supervisors.

• Promote high standards of food hygiene, product protection and contamination prevention

Supplier & Contractor Oversight

• Support approval and monitoring of suppliers, contractors and service providers involved in food handling or storage.

• Ensure third-party logistics partners operate in accordance with company food safety standards.

Performance & Reporting

• Monitor key food safety performance indicators including audit results, incidents and non-conformances.

• Prepare reports and improvement plans for senior management.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives across the logistics network.

Skills & Experience Required

Essential

• Experience in food safety or quality management within logistics, warehousing or food distribution.

• Strong knowledge of food safety management systems and regulatory requirements.

• Experience implementing HACCP and hygiene controls in storage and distribution environments.

• Experience supporting external food safety audits.

• Ability to influence operational teams and drive compliance.

Qualifications

• Level 4 Food Safety / HACCP qualification (or equivalent)

• HACCP certification

• Degree in Food Science, Food Safety, Environmental Health or related discipline (desirable)

title: Conseiller(ère) clientèle – Livraison et gestion des litiges
description:
Qui nous sommes

JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics) est la branche logistique de JD.com et l’un des principaux acteurs mondiaux des solutions supply-chain pilotées par la technologie. Forts d’une expertise avancée en automatisation, en gestion intelligente des flux et en analyse de données, nous opérons des services logistiques intégrés de bout en bout qui accompagnent les entreprises dans leur croissance et améliorent l’expérience client.

Nos réseaux couvrent l’ensemble de la chaîne logistique : gestion d’entrepôts, transport longue distance, livraison du dernier kilomètre, logistique des produits volumineux, chaîne du froid et opérations transfrontalières. Notre ambition : garantir vitesse, fiabilité et précision à chaque étape.

Notre présence internationale

JINGDONG Logistics a construit sur l’une des infrastructures logistiques les plus étendues au monde, avec plus de 3 600 entrepôts totalisant 34 millions de mètres carrés. Notre réseau international de logistique intelligente allie entrepôts hautement automatisés et solutions de transport international robustes, pour fluidifier les flux transfrontaliers.

Aujourd’hui, nous exploitons plus de 130 entrepôts (sous douane, en envoi direct ou à l'étranger) dans 23 pays et régions, à travers nos marques internationales JoyLogistics et JoyExpress — en pleine expansion pour renforcer l’empreinte logistique mondiale de JD.com.

En savoir plus sur qui nous sommes et ce que nous faisons : https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

Ce que nous offrons

Rejoindre JD Logistics, c’est contribuer activement à construire l’avenir de la supply-chain et de la logistique à l’échelle mondiale. Vous travaillerez sur des projets concrets autour des entrepôts intelligents, de la livraison autonome et des technologies innovantes qui font circuler les marchandises à travers le monde.

Nous proposons une rémunération compétitive, des locaux idéalement situés, et une culture d’entreprise centrée sur l’humain. Vous aurez l’opportunité de relever des défis stimulants, de développer vos compétences, et de faire une vraie différence dans un secteur en pleine transformation.

À propos de l’équipe

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe JD Logistics, où l’on valorise le travail d’équipe, la prise d’initiatives et l’engagement à délivrer des résultats de qualité dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant.

En tant que Conseiller clientèle livraisons et gestion des litiges, vos responsabilités seront les suivantes :
Appels sortants proactifs et planification : Effectuer des appels dans le cadre des missions de livraison ou de collecte, en logistique aller comme en logistique retour. Se présenter clairement et expliquer l’objet de l’appel à l’aide d’un script standardisé. Aider les clients à sélectionner un créneau dans le calendrier de planification, puis convenir avec eux d’un horaire précis pour la livraison ou l’enlèvement du colis.

Vérification et mise à jour des informations : Vérifier auprès des clients les informations essentielles, notamment l’adresse, les coordonnées de la personne à contacter et la nature des marchandises. Mettre à jour rapidement et précisément le système avec les créneaux confirmés et les éventuelles demandes particulières des clients.

Gestion des incidents : Gérer les imprévus tels que les reports, les annulations ou les conflits de planification. Mettre à jour les statuts correspondants dans le système et identifier les risques potentiels, comme une adresse incorrecte ou un client restant injoignable malgré plusieurs tentatives, afin d’enregistrer les anomalies.

Gestion de la satisfaction client et des réclamations : Réagir rapidement aux incidents et prendre en charge les réclamations clients nécessitant une escalade. Échanger de manière approfondie avec les clients et utiliser des techniques de négociation et d’indemnisation afin d’apporter une réponse adaptée à leurs besoins réels.

Gestion des pertes et des dommages : Enquêter sur les incidents majeurs, notamment les marchandises endommagées ou perdues, afin de déterminer les responsabilités. Appliquer les procédures d’évaluation des dommages, d’indemnisation ou de contestation des réclamations conformément à la politique de l’entreprise.

Traitement des demandes d’intervention : Réceptionner et traiter les différentes demandes liées aux incidents transmises par l’intermédiaire du système.

Profil recherché

• H/F, vous justifiez idéalement d’une première expérience dans le service client, la relation client, la logistique, le transport ou la gestion des réclamations.

• Vous disposez d’excellentes capacités de communication orale et êtes à l’aise avec les appels sortants et les échanges téléphoniques avec les clients.

• Vous savez faire preuve d’écoute, d’empathie et de diplomatie, y compris face à des clients mécontents ou dans des situations sensibles.

• Vous possédez de bonnes compétences en négociation et êtes capable de proposer des solutions adaptées aux besoins des clients, dans le respect des procédures de l’entreprise.

• Vous faites preuve de rigueur et de précision dans la vérification, la saisie et la mise à jour des informations dans les outils informatiques.

• Vous êtes capable de gérer les imprévus et les priorités, notamment les reports, les annulations, les erreurs d’adresse ainsi que les incidents liés aux livraisons, aux pertes ou aux dommages.

• Vous disposez de bonnes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes afin d’identifier les causes des incidents et de déterminer les actions appropriées.

• Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les logiciels de gestion de la relation client ou de suivi des opérations.

• Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez collaborer efficacement avec les services opérationnels, les équipes de livraison et les autres interlocuteurs internes.

Excellentes capacités d’organisation, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décision.

Capacité à travailler efficacement sous pression et à s’adapter à l’évolution des priorités.

title: Account Manager
description:
Who We Are

At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line-haul transportation, last-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.

Our Global Reach

JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Today, we operate 130+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

What We Offer

Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

職務内容

1.オペレーション品質管理

日々のオペレーションにおける異常データをモニタリングし、問題の根本原因を分析するとともに、オペレーションチームによる迅速な改善対応を推進する。顧客契約に基づくKPIの達成を確保し、サービスライフサイクル全体における顧客体験の向上を図る。

2.顧客関係維持・強化

定期的に顧客を訪問し、ニーズのヒアリングおよび分析を実施することで、顧客との信頼関係を構築・強化する。物流サービスに関する課題や問題を解決し、顧客満足度の向上および取引拡大（ウォレットシェアの向上）を推進する。

3.業務プロセス最適化の推進

オペレーションデータおよび業務シナリオを分析し、リーンマネジメントモデルを構築する。部門横断的な業務プロセスの最適化やサービス・プロダクトの改善を推進し、プロジェクト損失リスクの低減および業務効率の向上を実現する。

4.ビジネス機会の発掘・拡大

既存売上の達成状況を継続的にモニタリングし、未達要因を分析のうえ改善施策を立案・実行する。顧客の潜在ニーズを発掘し、新規ビジネスの導入・展開を推進することで、売上成長に貢献する。

5.部門横断的な調整・管理

社内外のリソースを統括し、オペレーション、営業、プロダクトなど関連部門と連携して顧客ニーズに迅速に対応する。複雑なサプライチェーンソリューションの標準化および円滑な運用を推進する。

職務要件

1.物流、サプライチェーン、アカウントマネジメント、カスタマーサクセス、またはプロジェクトマネジメント分野において2年以上の実務経験を有する方（物流業界での経験者歓迎）。

2. 優れた顧客関係管理およびビジネス開発能力を有し、主要顧客の管理、ビジネス機会の発掘、および売上拡大を推進できる方。

3. 高い分析力と部門横断的な調整能力を有し、業務改善、課題解決、および顧客満足度向上を推進できる方。

4. 中国語・日本語、または英語・日本語でビジネスレベルのコミュニケーションが可能な方。 顧客対応および社内外関係者との円滑なコミュニケーション能力をお持ちの方。

Job Description

1. Operational Quality Monitoring: Monitor daily operational exception data, analyze root causes, and drive the operations team to resolve issues quickly, ensuring KPI compliance with customer contracts and enhancing the full lifecycle service experience. Customer

2. Relationship Maintenance: Regularly visit customers, conduct needs assessments and deepen customer relationships to build and maintain trust. Resolve logistics service issues to improve customer satisfaction and increase wallet share.

3. Process Optimization Drive: Analyze operational data and business scenarios to build lean management models, drive cross-departmental process optimization and product iteration, reduce project loss risks, and improve operational efficiency.

4. Opportunity Identification and Conversion: Track existing revenue achievement, analyze reasons for underperformance and develop remedial actions, identify customer potential needs, promote new business implementation, and drive revenue growth.

5. Cross-Departmental Coordination Management: Coordinate internal and external resources, align with operations, sales, product, and other departments to respond quickly to customer needs and drive the standardization of complex supply chain solutions.

Job Requirement:

1. 2 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, account management, customer success, or project management, preferably within the logistics industry. 2. Strong customer relationship management and business development skills, with the ability to manage key accounts, identify opportunities, and drive revenue growth.

3. Excellent analytical and cross-functional coordination skills, capable of driving operational improvements, resolving issues, and enhancing customer satisfaction.

4. Ability to communicate professionally in Chinese and Japanese, or Japanese and English.

职位内容

1. 运营质量管理

监控日常运营中的异常数据，分析问题根本原因，并推动运营团队快速落实改善措施。确保达成客户合同约定的KPI指标，提升整个服务生命周期中的客户体验。

2. 客户关系维护与深化

定期拜访客户，了解并分析客户需求，建立并深化客户信任关系。解决物流服务相关问题，提升客户满意度，并推动业务拓展（提升客户钱包份额/合作规模）。

3. 推动业务流程优化

分析运营数据及业务场景，构建精益管理体系。推动跨部门业务流程优化及服务、产品改善，降低项目亏损风险，提高运营效率。

4. 发掘与拓展商业机会

持续监控现有业务收入达成情况，分析未达标原因并制定改善方案。挖掘客户潜在需求，推动新业务导入与落地，为业绩增长作出贡献。

5. 跨部门协调与管理

统筹内部及外部资源，与运营、销售、产品等相关部门协作，快速响应客户需求。推动复杂供应链解决方案的标准化及顺畅运营。

任职要求

1. 拥有2年以上物流、供应链、客户管理（Account Management）、客户成功（Customer Success）或项目管理相关工作经验；具备物流行业经验者优先。2. 具备优秀的客户关系管理及业务开发能力，能够负责重点客户管理、挖掘商业机会并推动业务增长。

3. 具备较强的数据分析能力及跨部门协调能力，能够推动业务改善、解决问题并提升客户满意度。

4. 具备商务水平的中文和日语，或英语和日语沟通能力；能够与客户及内外部相关方进行顺畅、高效的沟通。

At JINGDONG Logistics, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Ready to apply?

Take the next step in your career, apply now and explore the opportunities we have to offer.

title: Social Media & Influencers Manager
description:
Who We Are

Joybuy is JD.com’s dedicated retail platform for Europe, offering products across a wide range of categories. Operating across the UK, Netherlands, Germany, France, Belgium and Luxembourg, we’re building the future of retail through smart systems, bold ideas, and a customer-first mindset. Backed by JD.com, also known as JINGDONG, and its trusted global technology and supply chain ecosystem, we deliver a shopping experience that is speedy, reliable, and genuinely enjoyable. If you’re ready to make a difference, bring your talent and grow with us. Don’t just buy, Joybuy.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://about.joybuy.com/about/

What We Offer

Joining Joybuy means becoming part of a business where people, innovation, and impact work together to shape the future of cross-border e-commerce. You’ll contribute to smart supply chains, efficient logistics, and meaningful projects that drive real customer value. With a competitive salary, great office locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to grow your career, learn from talented colleagues, and make a genuine impact in a fast-expanding international business.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the Joybuy team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

About the Role

We're looking for a Social Media & Influencers Manager to develop Joybuy UK's social media presence, lead influencer partnerships and execute offline activations that drive customer engagement, brand awareness and commercial performance.

This is a hands-on role combining strategy and execution, where you'll own social media, influencer marketing and local activations to grow awareness, engage communities and support commercial performance.

Your Key Responsabilities:

Develop Joybuy's social media presence

•
Define and execute Joybuy's social media strategy across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant platforms.

•
Own the social content calendar, aligning content with commercial priorities, product launches and seasonal campaigns.

•
Partner with creative teams to produce engaging, platform-native content.

•
Monitor performance, analyse insights and continuously optimise content based on engagement, traffic and conversion metrics.

Build and scale influencer partnerships

•
Identify, recruit and manage influencers, creators and brand ambassadors aligned with Joybuy's brand.

•
Develop long-term partnerships across different audience segments.

•
Lead influencer campaigns end-to-end, from briefing and negotiation through execution and performance analysis.

•
Track ROI and measure the impact of influencer activity on engagement, traffic and sales

Deliver impactful offline events

•
Plan and execute offline events and brand activations that complement online campaigns and strengthen customer engagement.

•
Coordinate agencies, venues and external partners to ensure flawless execution.

•
Capture and repurpose event content across social channels to maximise reach and impact.

What We're Looking For:

•
3+ years of experience in Social Media and Influencer Marketing, managing social media channels and influencer campaigns.

•
Hands-on mindset with a willingness to execute directly: comfortable owning day-to-day social media management, personally identifying and engaging influencers, and coordinating offline events and brand activations from planning through delivery.

•

POSITION SUMMARY

The Corporate Services, Compliance & Risk Specialist will support the company’s administrative operations and coordinate local compliance and risk control activities in Brazil.

The position will work closely with local business teams, external service providers, professional advisors, and the company’s headquarters in China to ensure that administrative and business activities follow internal policies and applicable local regulations.

This is a hands-on operational position requiring strong organization, attention to detail, risk awareness, integrity, and the ability to coordinate and follow up with multiple stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Compliance and Risk Control

• Support the implementation of the company’s compliance and risk control policies in Brazil.

• Conduct preliminary compliance reviews and due diligence on customers, suppliers, and other business partners.

• Support KYC procedures, sanctions screening, conflict-of-interest checks, third-party risk assessments, and other internal control processes.

• Review and organize corporate and transactional documents required for compliance assessments and internal approvals.

• Monitor business and operational activities to identify potential compliance risks, process gaps, irregularities, or suspicious transactions.

• Maintain accurate records of compliance reviews, identified risks, corrective actions, and supporting evidence.

• Follow up with responsible teams to ensure that risk mitigation actions are completed within the required deadlines.

• Assist in documenting and handling potential policy violations and compliance incidents.

• Escalate material risks or suspected violations to local management and the relevant headquarters teams.

• Coordinate compliance-related matters with Legal, Finance, HR, Procurement, business teams, and headquarters’ Risk Control team.

• Support internal audits, compliance assessments, anti-corruption initiatives, and employee awareness training.

Office Administration and Facilities

• Support the daily operation of the Brazil office, ensuring that facilities, equipment, supplies, and shared areas are properly maintained.

Supplier and Service Provider Management

• Identify and coordinate local suppliers for administrative and corporate services.

• Request and compare quotations, support supplier selection, and follow up on service delivery.

• Conduct preliminary checks on supplier documentation and potential compliance risks.

• Organize invoices, contracts, quotations, and supporting documents for internal approval and payment processes.

• Monitor service quality, deadlines, documentation, and compliance with agreed conditions.

Asset and Inventory Administration

• Maintain accurate records of company assets, including laptops, mobile phones, badges, furniture, and other equipment.

• Support asset allocation, return, inventory verification, maintenance, and replacement processes.

• Coordinate equipment-related requirements with IT and other relevant teams.

• Ensure that asset management activities follow the company’s internal procedures and approval requirements.

Corporate Documentation

• Support the organization, renewal, and filing of corporate documents, licenses, certificates, and administrative records.

• Coordinate document submissions and follow up with external service providers, government agencies, and internal departments when required.

• Maintain organized and updated physical and digital records.

• Ensure that supporting documentation is complete and available for internal controls, compliance reviews, and audits.

Employee and Expatriate Support

• Provide administrative support to local employees and expatriates regarding office access, equipment, local services, and general workplace needs.

• Coordinate administrative activities related to employee onboarding, transfers, and offboarding.

• Support expatriates with local administrative procedures in coordination with HR and the relevant internal teams.

• Ensure that sensitive employee and corporate information is handled confidentially.

Meetings, Events and Business Support

• Support the organization of internal meetings, employee activities, business visits, and corporate events.

• Coordinate venues, transportation, meals, materials, and other logistical arrangements.

• Provide administrative and logistical support for visiting employees and executives.

• Ensure that related expenses and arrangements follow internal policies and approved budgets.

Process Improvement and Cross-Functional Coordination

• Identify operational risks, control weaknesses, and opportunities to improve administrative processes.

• Propose and implement practical improvements to increase efficiency, compliance, and traceability.

• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve operational bottlenecks and close pending action items.

• Prepare reports, records, and supporting materials for management and headquarters when required.

REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Law, Economics, or a related field.

• Previous experience in corporate services, compliance, internal controls, risk management, audit, office administration, or related activities.

• Experience reviewing corporate documents and coordinating suppliers, invoices, contracts, and administrative processes.

• Knowledge of Brazilian corporate compliance, anti-corruption, data protection, and internal control requirements.

• Experience with third-party due diligence, KYC, sanctions screening, or risk assessment is preferred.

• Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple activities, stakeholders, and deadlines.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

• Native or fluent Portuguese.

• Professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese.

• English is considered a strong advantage.

• Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and international environment.

• High level of integrity, confidentiality, accountability, and professional judgment.

• Hands-on, detail-oriented, proactive, and solution-focused profile.

Drive campaign merchandising strategy: Partner with local merchandising teams, cross-border procurement and country operations to define product selection, Hero SKUs, pricing, inventory readiness and promotional mechanics.

•
Develop promotional frameworks: Design and optimise commercial mechanics including flash sales, bundles, coupons, tiered promotions and other initiatives to maximise customer engagement and commercial performance.

Leverage AI and data: Use AI and data-driven insights to improve campaign planning, reporting, performance monitoring and operational efficiency.

What We're Looking For

•
5-10 years in e-commerce operations, campaign management, or commercial planning, preferably at a retailer, marketplace, or digital-first brand

•
Deep understanding of e-commerce mechanics: product selection, pricing, promotions, inventory management, and how they interact

•
Proven experience delivering large-scale campaigns (Black Friday, Christmas, or equivalent) end-to-end — not just supporting, but owning

•
Strong cross-functional coordination skills: able to align multiple teams (merchandising, procurement, operations, marketing) around a shared plan

•
Deep local insight into UK/European consumer behaviour, retail seasonality, and e-commerce trends

•
Experience working at an e-commerce platform or marketplace (not just agency-side)

•
Comfortable with ambiguity and fast decision-making — we're a startup within a large organisation

•
AI fluency: you actively use AI tools in your work and stay current with trends

•
Owner mindset: you take accountability for results, not just process. You proactively identify and solve problems without waiting for instructions

•
Highly organised, detail-oriented, but able to see the big picture and prioritise accordingly

•
Fluent English

Nice to have:

•
Understanding of merchandising and product buying logic

•
Experience working across multiple European markets

•
Another European language or Mandarin

About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and business-oriented Business Analyst to support the growth of our Marketplace (POP) business. In this role, you will partner closely with Business, Category, Supply Chain, Operations, Product, and Finance teams to deliver data-driven insights, identify growth opportunities, and drive operational excellence across the marketplace ecosystem.

• Analyze Marketplace (POP) business performance and develop regular business reviews, dashboards, and management reports.

• Drive automation and continuous improvement of reporting and analytical processes.

• Present insights and recommendations to business leaders and senior management.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into business insights.

• Advanced SQL skills are required; experience with Python or R is a plus.

• Proficiency in Excel and BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.

• Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Fluent in English; Mandarin is a plus.

Data-Driven Decision Making: Utilize HR analytics to identify organizational trends, proactively proposing improvements to HR operations and talent workflows.

Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience as an HRBP, ideally in e-commerce, retail, or logistics. A combination of experience in large organizations and fast-growing environments (e.g., scale-ups) is strongly preferred.

Functional Expertise: Proven track record in at least one specialized HR module (e.g., talent management, organizational design, or compensation).

Skills: Exceptional cognitive and learning agility. Proven ability to navigate complex interpersonal dynamics and build trust with senior stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field from an accredited institution.

Local Knowledge: Solid expertise in UK employment legislation and regulations as well as local HR best practices.

description:
Who We Are

JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Today, we operate 130+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

What We Offer

Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Field Service Technician – EV-laders, Zonnepanelen, Thuisbatterijen & Huishoudapparatuur

Locatie: Waddinxveen, NL

Functieomschrijving

Als Field Service Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de installatie, inbedrijfstelling, het onderhoud en het oplossen van storingen aan EV-laadstations, residentiële zonnepaneelsystemen, thuisbatterijen en grote huishoudelijke elektrische apparaten (zoals koelkasten, wasmachines, drogers en vaatwassers). Deze functie vereist sterke technische expertise, klantgerichte communicatie en een strikte naleving van veiligheids- en kwaliteitsnormen.

• Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden:

• Installatie van EV-laders: Het installeren, configureren, testen en opleveren van laadsystemen voor elektrische voertuigen bij consumenten thuis, volgens de technische specificaties en veiligheidsvoorschriften.

• Installatie van Zonnepanelen: Het volledig installeren van residentiële PV-systemen, inclusief het monteren van componenten, het aansluiten van omvormers, de bekabeling en het waarborgen van de conformiteit met elektrische normen.

• Installatie van Thuisbatterijen: Het installeren en integreren van residentiële energieopslagsystemen met bestaande zonnepanelen en EV-laadinfrastructuur.

• Installatie van Witgoed & Huishoudapparatuur: Het installeren, aansluiten en testen van grote huishoudelijke apparaten en zorgen voor een correcte en veilige elektrische integratie.

• Het uitvoeren van technische inspecties op locatie Het uitvoeren van technische inspecties op locatie en het geven van helder installatieadvies.

• Zorgen dat alle werkzaamheden strikt voldoen aan de NEN-normen en de interne veiligheidsprocedures van het bedrijf.

• Het nauwkeurig bijhouden van de documentatie, waaronder installatieverslagen, dagrapporten en technische bevindingen.

Het geven van een korte uitleg en instructie aan de klant over de werking van het systeem na oplevering.

Functie-eisen:

• Opleiding: Minimaal een afgeronde MBO- of HBO-opleiding in de richting van Elektrotechniek, Energietechniek, Duurzame Energie of een vergelijkbare technische discipline.

• Ervaring: Minimaal 1 jaar relevante werkervaring in een technische of buitendienstomgeving.

• Rijbewijs: Een geldig rijbewijs (Categorie B) is absoluut vereist voor deze func

• tie.Kennis: Sterk inzicht in residentiële elektrotechnische installaties, bedrading en montagetechnieken.

Certificeringen: Je bent bij voorkeur al in het bezit van NEN 3140 en NEN 1010, VCA Basis, of je bent bereid deze via ons te behalen.

Gewenste Vaardigheden & Competenties:

• Ervaring met de installatie van EV-laders, zonnepanelen, thuisbatterijen of groot huishoudelijk witgoed is een sterkepré.

• In staat om elektrische schema's en installatiehandleidingen zelfstandig te lezen en te interpreteren.

• Sterk probleemoplossend vermogen en oog voor detail.

• Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling.

• In staat om zelfstandig te werken en meerdere installatie-afspraken per dag efficiënt te beheren.

Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal; beheersing van de Nederlandse taal is sterk gewenst.

Wat Wij Bieden:

• Een competitief salaris en goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.

• Uitgebreide ondersteuning bij trainingen en het behalen van certificeringen (waaronder NEN en VCA).

• De kans om te werken met de nieuwste technologieën op het gebied van duurzame energie.

• Een betrouwbare, veilige werkomgeving waarin teamwerk en technische expertise centraal staan.

Who We Are

At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line-haul transportation, last-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.

Our Global Reach

JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Today, we operate 130+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.

Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/

What We Offer

Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.

About The Team

You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Job Description

• Manage end-to-end warehouse operations across inbound, inventory management, and outbound processes, ensuring safe, efficient, and accurate execution.

• Monitor key operational KPIs, including productivity, throughput, order accuracy, inventory accuracy, and on-time fulfillment, driving continuous operational improvements.

• Develop daily production plans and workforce allocation based on business demand to maximize productivity and resource utilization.

• Supervise daily warehouse operations, coordinate with team leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, and resolve operational issues to ensure smooth execution.

• Lead or support process improvement initiatives by optimizing workflows, standardizing operating procedures (SOPs), and improving operational efficiency and quality.

• Ensure compliance with safety regulations, quality standards, and company policies while maintaining a safe and productive working environment.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or above, with at least 3 years of experience in warehouse operations, warehouse management, logistics, or supply chain operations.

• Solid understanding of warehouse operations, production management, inventory control, and warehouse performance management.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills, with the ability to drive operational improvements.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple teams.

• Proficiency in both English and Chinese (written and spoken) is required.

• Experience with WMS, ERP, Lean Manufacturing, or continuous improvement methodologies is preferred.

At JINGDONG Logistics, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Ready to apply?

Take the next step in your career, apply now and explore the opportunities we have to offer.
